notes: Makes 3 loaves. A small amount of the flour can be used to dredge berries. This keeps berries from sinking to the bottom. HOW TO MEASURE FLOUR: Flour should be sifted and then spooned into a measuring cup. The cup should be tapped very gently and then leveled off with the flat edge of a knife. Flour should not be packed into the measuring cup. Eat one while it's warm and wrap the others in foil and freeze.
pdfLink: pdfs/Ukrop's Words Worth Eating Blueberry Bread (From Ukrops Words Worth Eating).pdf

title: Ultimate Pancakes
ingredients: 2 cups Bisquick Original or Reduced Fat baking mix
directions: STIR ingredients until blended.
POUR by scant ¼ cupfuls onto hot griddle.
COOK until edges are dry. Turn; cook until golden.
notes: Yields 12 or 13 pancakes. For Reduced Fat baking mix, use skim milk and 3 egg whites instead of 2 eggs. High Altitude: No changes.

title: Veg. Sauce
directions: Cream together butter, Parmesan cheese, and salt.
Blend in sour cream, chives, and cucumber.
Spread over vegetables.
notes: Yield: 3 cups

title: Vegetable Burger Soup
directions: In a Dutch oven or large saucepan, brown ground beef.
Stir in tomatoes, tomato sauce, water, frozen vegetables, onion soup mix, and sugar.
Bring to boiling.
Reduce heat.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
notes: Recipe from: Jirri Bird; Serves: 6-8

title: Walnut Pear Salad
ingredients: 5-6 cups of baby greens or micro lettuces
3 ripe pears, unpared with cores removed
1 4-ounce package crumbled blue cheese (or 3-4 ounces of your favorite blue cheese, crumbled)
directions: Prepare greens, pears and walnuts; arrange on plates and set aside.
Whisk all dressing ingredients except cheese; add cheese and spoon over salad.
notes: Yields 4-6 salads. Delicious with grilled meats or seafood.

title: Waffles
directions: Sift flour, sugar, salt, and baking powder in mixing bowl.
Beat yolks well, add milk.
Add yolk mixture to flour slowly.
Beat until smooth.
Then add melted butter and fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.
Cook 3 mins/waffle.
notes: 1/2 recipe: 2T sugar, 1 cup flour, 3/4 cup milk, 1 egg, 1 1/2 teaspoon. baking powder, 1/4 t salt, 3T melted butter. Add pecans if desired or pour praline syrup over. Add water if batter is too thick. Leftovers: refrigerator batter, then add 1/2-1T baking powder and milk.

title: Warm Cheese Dip - Jerri Bird's
directions: Mix all ingredients except nuts.
Sprinkle 1/4 c nuts over top.
Bake 350° for 15 mins.
Serve warm with crackers, celery, or carrots.
notes: The original recipe lists the sour cream as an 'add' after mixing, and lists nuts as a separate step.

title: Watergate Salad White House Salad
directions: Mix undrained pineapple and pudding by pouring pudding into pineapple.
Stir; add rest of ingredients.
Stir by hand.
Chill 2 full days before serving - never less than one day.
notes: Recipe specifies to chill for 2 full days, noting never to chill for less than one day.

title: Watsons Cheese Potatoes - Microwave
directions: Pierce potatoes, cook on high for 10-20 mins, cool.
Melt butter, add cheese, sour cream, salt/pepper, and onions.
Stir mixture together.
Place in 8x12 glass dish that has been greased.
Cook on high for 8 mins.
Serves 8.

title: Whiskey Punch
ingredients: Orange, lemon, and pineapple slices for garnish
directions: Pour ingredients over a large piece of ice or 2 trays of ice cubes.
Add ginger ale and sugar to taste.
Decorate with orange, lemon, and pineapple slices.
notes: Recipe is for 12 people; makes 15 servings (4 ounce each).

title: White Clam Sauce
directions: Heat oil in saucepan.
Add butter, simmer for 2 minutes.
Add garlic, parsley, basil, cheese, cayenne, and pepper.
Bring to a boil.
Stir in clams.
Serve with linguine.
notes: Recipe signed by Nancy, dated 12-03-06.

title: White Sangria
directions: Combine wine, curaçao, sugar, and sliced fruit in a pitcher.
Add club soda only before serving to keep bubbly.
notes: Makes 6 servings.

title: Wine Punch
directions: Dilute lemonade
Add rest and serve
notes: Recipe from the kitchen of Mary Kaye Long. Serves 6.

title: Winter Bean Soup
ingredients: 2 leeks, white and pale green sliced into matchsticks, soaked, drained, dried
Kosher salt AND freshly ground black pepper
½ teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
1 sprig EACH: fresh rosemary, fresh thyme
2 cups thinly sliced lacinato kale leaves
directions: In a large pot, heat oil over medium-low. Add leeks, carrots, celery and garlic. Cook, stirring, until vegetables are softened and fragrant, about 8 minutes. Season with 1 teaspoon salt, ½ teaspoon black pepper and the crushed red pepper.

Tie together rosemary, thyme and bay leaf; toss this bundle into the pot. Stir in beans, ham and tomatoes. Pour in 6 cups broth. Bring to a boil, lower to a simmer. Cover and let simmer until beans turn tender and flavorful, about 1 hour 45 minutes for dried beans, about 30 minutes for canned.
As the beans simmer, add some of the remaining broth, if needed. The goal is a broth swimming with beans, not a thick chili-style mash.

When beans are tender, taste the broth and season with more salt and pepper, if needed. Discard herb bundle. Stir in kale, cover, and cook until tender, about 10 minutes. Scoop soup into bowls. Dust with Parmesan. Enjoy hot.
notes: Cover ½ pound dried cannellini beans with cold water and let soak overnight, drain and rinse; OR cover ½ pound dried beans with cold water, boil 1 minute, let soak 1 hour, drain and rinse; OR open 2 15-ounce cans of cannellini beans, drain and rinse. (If using canned beans, add only ½ teaspoon salt to sautéed vegetables; taste before adding more.)

title: Zesty Cheese Bits
directions: Grate cheese.
Leave out butter at room temperature.
Mix remaining ingredients together.
Roll in long thin rolls & wrap in wax paper.
Place in freezer 15 mins. before cutting.
Remove & slice on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake 15 mins. at 300°.
notes: Recipe from the kitchen of Mary Kaye Long.

title: Zucchini and Caramelized-onion Pizza
ingredients: 1 pound store-bought pizza dough, room temperature
1 medium zucchini, thinly shaved lengthwise with a vegetable peeler or mandoline (3½ cups)
Kosher salt and freshly ground pepper
½ cup pitted Kalamata olives, halved
½ cup fresh mint leaves, torn if large
directions: Preheat oven to 450°, with a rack in lower third. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a skillet over medium-high. Add onions and garlic; cook, stirring frequently, until onions are soft and golden, about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, brush a 13-by-18-inch rimmed baking sheet with 2 tablespoons oil. Place dough on center of sheet and, using your hands, stretch and fit it to edges.
Toss zucchini with remaining 1 tablespoon oil; season with salt and pepper. Spread onion mixture evenly over dough, leaving a ½-inch border. Top with zucchini; sprinkle with feta.
Bake until crust is golden brown and zucchini is tender, about 25 minutes. Top with olives and mint; sprinkle with red-pepper flakes. Cut into pieces and serve.
notes: Active time: 25 min. | Total time: 55 min. | Serves: 4

title: Toasted Almond Green Beans
ingredients: 2 cans (14.5 ounce. each) Del Monte® Cut Green Beans, drained
directions: Heat large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add almonds; cook 2–3 minutes or until browned, stirring frequently, being careful not to burn.
Add 2 tablespoons butter, Worcestershire sauce, lemon juice and cumin. Cook until butter has melted, stirring constantly.
Set almonds aside on separate plate.
Melt remaining butter in same skillet over medium-high heat.
Add beans and cook 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove from heat; season with salt and pepper.
Sprinkle almond mixture over beans. Toss and let stand 5 minutes before serving.
notes: Makes 6 servings, 1/2 cup each. Per serving: 150 calories, 13g fat, 4g saturated fat, 15mg cholesterol, 300mg sodium, 7g carbohydrate, 3g fiber, 2g sugars, 4g protein.

title: Toasted Almond Truffles
ingredients: one 11 1/2 ounce package (2 cups) milk chocolate morsels
directions: Combine evaporated milk and sugar in small heavy gauge saucepan.
Cook over medium heat until mixture comes to a full rolling boil.
Boil 3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat.
Stir in morsels and almond extract until morsels melt and mixture is smooth.
Chill 45 minutes.
Shape into 1-inch balls.
Roll in almonds.
Chill until ready to serve.
notes: Cheryl Bergen '91

title: Doug's Fudge
directions: Line an 8x8 pan with aluminum foil.
Spray with Pam.
Melt ingredients over low heat.
Pour into pan and smooth.
Spread into pan.
Refrigerate 2 hours, then sprinkle with crushed peppermint candy.
notes: Recipe from the kitchen of Sarah Allen, dated 12-14. Also references a clipped recipe for Foolproof Dark Chocolate Fudge and Rocky Road Fudge from Borden Eagle Brand.

title: Never-fail Fudge
directions: Melt butter, add sugar and cream.
Bring to boil and boil 6 minutes.
Then add vanilla and chips (chocolate or butterscotch).
May add nuts.
Pour into jelly roll pan with parchment paper.
Cool - cut before too hard.
notes: Peggy Schoolar, 2003

title: Chocolate Truffles
ingredients: 7 ounces bittersweet Swiss chocolate, cut into 1 inch pieces
3/4 cup powdered sugar, measured, then sifted
1 to 2 tablespoons dark rum or raspberry flavored liqueur
directions: Combine chocolate, cream, and butter in top of double boiler over simmering water.
Add sugar and yolks and whisk until smooth.
Remove from heat and rum to taste.
Place in shallow glass dish and chill until malleable (2 hours) in refrigerator or 1 hour in freezer.
Shape into small balls about size of walnuts, roll in cocoa.
Place in paper candy cups and refrigerate until hardened.
notes: Laura Gough '86

title: Nut Truffles
ingredients: 1/2 cup ground hazelnuts, almonds, or walnuts
directions: In a medium bowl, beat butter and powdered sugar until creamy, set aside.
Melt chocolate in small heavy saucepan, cool.
Stir cooled chocolate into butter mixture, beat until smooth and creamy.
Stir in 1/2 of nuts, refrigerate 30 minutes.
Place in a single layer on lined baking sheet (waxed paper), refrigerate until firm (small balls).
Roll in remaining nuts and place in paraffin paper small cups.
Store in containers with tight lid.
Makes 30 candies
notes: Recipe source: Laura Gough

title: Chocolates
directions: Mix above thoroughly.
Shape into small balls.
Chill.
Melt 3/4 bar paraffin and 2 large packages (6 1/2 ounces) chocolate chips in double boiler.
Dip balls in chocolate mixture using toothpicks.
Fill in where toothpick was hitting chocolate dip.
notes: Mom Willett

title: Christmas Walnut Brittle
directions: Grease large cookie sheet and sides.
In heavy 2 quart saucepan over medium heat, heat sugar, corn syrup, water, and salt to boiling - stir frequently until sugar is dissolved.
Stir in walnuts - carefully set candy thermometer in place and continue cooking - stir until temperature reaches 300° or hard crack stage - about 20 minutes.
Remove saucepan from heat - stir in butter and baking soda - pour mixture at once onto cookie sheet (marble slab).
Cool. Break into small pieces.
notes: Make #1

title: Bierds Fudge
directions: Prepare a 9x13-inch buttered pan.
Mix sugar and condensed milk together.
Heat to a full boil, and cook for 6 minutes while stirring.
Remove from heat.
Add 1 stick margarine and 18 ounces chocolate chips.
Add 3 teaspoons vanilla and nuts.

title: Fudge
directions: Cook 7 minutes.
Remove from stove, add 2 packages chocolate chips, 1 pound nuts; 1-2 9 ounce (perhaps more) marshmallow creme.
Beat and pour into greased platter.
notes: Mrs. Hodge

title: Toffee - Neverfail Candy
directions: Melt butter on low heat and add sugar and water, heat on high to boil, and cook until it turns light brown.
Spread nuts in 8x8 pan, pour over nuts.
Place chocolate on top, let melt, then spread.
Cool and break up.

title: English Almond Toffee
ingredients: 1/2 cup semi sweet chocolate pieces or 2 - 7/8 ounce milk chocolate bars
directions: Combine in saucepan: 2/3 cup butter, 1/2 cup sugar, 1/3 cup water, 1/2 teaspoon salt.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly until it boils.
Cook and stirring to 236 degrees or until a little dropped in cold H2O forms soft ball.
Add: 2/3 cup blanched almonds.
Continue cooking to 290 degrees (soft crack stage), stirring constantly.
Remove from heat.
Mixture changes to a deep carmel color.
Stir in 1/4 teaspoon soda.
Turn out onto greased baking sheet, spread to 1/4" thickness.
Immediately spread with 1/2 cup semi sweet chocolate pieces or 2 - 7/8 ounce milk chocolate bars.
Spread chocolate over top as it melts.
Sprinkle with 1/2 cup chopped pecans.
Cool: Break into pieces.
notes: Marked as "Very Good"

title: Butter Mints
ingredients: 7 drops oil of peppermint or wintergreen
directions: Mix sugar and water and place over heat.
Stir until sugar is dissolved.
Clean pan with gauze wrapped around knife or fork.
Add butter, continue cooking without stirring till thermometer reaches 264 degrees Fahrenheit (El Paso cook to 252 degrees Fahrenheit).
Remove from heat.
Pour in large flat pan which has been greased (cookie sheet with sides). (Do not scrape pan.)
Cool until it can be handled comfortably, turning in edges as it cools.
Add peppermint or wintergreen and coloring and pull like taffy.
Cut with scissors.
Cool and store in tin.
notes: Marked as "Very Good" - Nell Lennon - Fort Bliss. White - plain. Green - oil of wintergreen. Red - oil of peppermint.

title: Choc. Candy
directions: Cut Hershey Bars in small chips
Put in mixing bowl with chocolate chips, marshmallow creme, and nuts.
Put sugar, margarine, and Pet cream in saucepan. At boiling point let boil 9 minutes.
When done pour over Hershey mixture and beat until creamy.
Pour onto greased platters.
notes: Makes 5 pounds

title: Spiced Nuts
directions: Boil until soft ball in cold water
Then drop nuts in it and let harden on wax paper.

title: Four Fabulous Flavors - One Basic Recipe
ingredients: Orange: 1/2 cup orange juice plus 1 1/2 teaspoons finely grated rind and 6 drops orange coloring.
Sherry: 1/2 cup cream sherry plus 1 1/2 teaspoons shredded lemon peel.
Spiced: 1/2 cup water plus 1/2 teaspoon each nutmeg and cloves, and 2 teaspoons cinnamon.
Mint: 1/2 cup milk plus 4 drops red coloring. Add 1 teaspoon peppermint flavoring with walnuts.
directions: In 2-quart saucepan, mix first 4 ingredients.
Cook to soft ball stage (238 degrees Fahrenheit).
Add walnuts and stir till creamy.
Quickly turn out on waxed paper and separate with forks.
notes: Four flavor variations included: Orange, Sherry, Spiced, and Mint.
pdfLink: Four Fabulous Flavors - One Basic Recipe.pdf

title: Mother's Mints
directions: Mix thoroughly and boil to 265 degrees.
Remove from fire, add small amount of desired food coloring and 1 teaspoon of oil of peppermint or wintergreen.
Pour out on marble slab - cool then stretch; pull out and cut.
Cookie sheet for marble maybe substituted.
notes: Christa Derges

title: Fresh Peach Pie
ingredients: 6 large ripe peaches, peeled and sliced
directions: Line the pie crust with half of the sliced peaches.
Combine cheese, milk, lemon juice and vanilla; mix well.
Pour over the peaches; top with remaining peaches.
Cover with plastic wrap and allow to chill 3-6 hours before serving.
Serves 6.
notes:
"Layers of peaches in a cool and creamy filling."
Note: A prepared pie crust is fine for this recipe.
"Better make two! This pie will disappear before your eyes!"

title: Fresh Peach Pie
ingredients: 3 cups ripe peaches, peeled and sliced
directions: Grind almonds, add to coconut, sugar, and butter. Mix together.
Save 3 tablespoons of mixture for pie topping - toast this foil 5 minutes in oven.
Pat mixture into a 9 inch pie pan and bake at 375 degrees for 10 to 12 minutes.
Beat sour cream and all ingredients except peaches.
Spread mixture on bottom and side of pie shell - cover with peaches that powdered fruit "fresh fruit" has been added.
Top with whipped cream and 2 tablespoons powdered sugar.
Then add remaining toasted coconut mixture.
notes: Helen Spaul, July 2010

title: Peach Pie Upside Down
ingredients: 2/3 cup (4 ounces) toasted sliced almonds or pecan halves
directions: Line 9-inch pie pan with 12-inch square of foil. Let excess foil overhang edge. Spread with

title: Luscious Creamy Cheese Lemon Pie
ingredients: 1 lemon, sliced paper thin for garnish (optional)
directions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.
Place cream cheese in medium mixing bowl; beat in sugar until fluffy.
Beat in egg; add sour cream, lemon rind, lemon juice and vanilla.
Pour into crust and bake for 20 minutes or until filling is set.
Cool completely on a cake rack.
When cool, glaze with topping.
Serves 6.
Topping: Mix sugar, cornstarch and salt in a small pan; stir in water.
Beat egg yolk into the sugar mixture.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens and boils for 3 minutes.
Remove from heat; stir in lemon rind, lemon juice, butter and vanilla.
Cool.
Spread over pie.
notes: Can be made a day ahead. 'A delightful summer dessert!'

title: Creamy Lemon Meringue Pie
directions: Cook milk, 1 cup sugar, and cornstarch until thick.
Add 3 egg yolks and cook for 2 minutes or until thick.
Stir in butter, lemon juice, lemon rind, and 1/4 cup sour cream.
Beat egg whites with cream of tartar, 6 tablespoons sugar, and a little vanilla to make meringue.
Top pie with meringue and bake.
notes: Blanche Showalter 1975

title: Mom Willette's Classic Lemon Meringue Pie
directions: Mix sugar, salt, flour - then add lemon juice, grated rind and egg yolks, then boiling water.
Cook until thick in double boiler.
Use egg whites for the top.
notes: Mom Willette
pdfLink: Mom Willette's Classic Lemon Meringue Pie.pdf

title: Classic Homemade Lemon Pie with Meringue
ingredients: 2 teaspoons grated lemon or lime rind
directions: Mix flour, cornstarch and sugar.
Add boiling water.
Cook until thick.
Blend in egg yolks and cook 3 minutes longer.
For Meringue: Beat 1/4 teaspoon salt, 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar, 3 egg whites, and 6 tablespoons sugar.
Bake in preheated oven 350 degrees Fahrenheit about 18 minutes.
notes: Marked as "Good"
pdfLink: Classic Homemade Lemon Pie with Meringue.pdf

title: Classic Southern Lemon Chess Pie with Cornmeal Crust
directions: Combine sugar, eggs, toss together flour and cornmeal and add to mixture.
Gradually add milk, butter, lemon juice and rind.
Pour into 1 large or two small unbaked pastry shells and bake 45 minutes at 375 degrees (cornmeal will rise to form delicious crust over pie).
1 cup of pecans can be added, if desired.
notes: Mom Hodge
pdfLink: Classic Southern Lemon Chess Pie with Cornmeal Crust.pdf

title: Mother's Classic Lemon Sponge Dessert Pie
ingredients: juice of 1 lemon and lemon zest
directions: Combine flour, sugar and salt.
Beat egg whites until stiff.
Cream butter - add egg yolks, lemon juice and milk - Stir in dry ingredients - Fold in egg whites.
Bake in low oven 325 degrees for 30 minutes.
Set in pan of water to bake.
notes: A favorite recipe from Nancy Dawson - Mother (Beryl Willett)
pdfLink: Mother's Classic Lemon Sponge Dessert Pie.pdf

title: Classic Grasshopper Pie with Chocolate Wafer Crust
ingredients: chocolate wafers, enough to make 1.5 cups fine crumbs
directions: With a rolling pin, crush enough chocolate wafers to make 1.5 cups fine crumbs.
Mix crumbs with 0.25 cup each sugar and melted butter.
Press the crumbs firmly against the bottom and sides of a well buttered pie plate.
Bake crust in very hot oven (450 degrees Fahrenheit) for 5 minutes and then cool it.
Soften 1.5 teaspoons gelatin in 0.33 cup heavy cream and dissolve it over hot water.
Beat 0.25 cup sugar into four beaten egg yolks.
Stir in 0.25 cup each of creme de cacao and creme de menthe (green) and the dissolved gelatin.
Chill the mixture until it is slightly thickened.
Fold in 1 cup heavy cream whipped.
Pour the filling into the prepared shell and chill pie until it is firm.
Sprinkle the pie with crushed mint-flavored chocolate.
notes: Submitted by C. H., Madison Mills, Virginia.
pdfLink: Classic Grasshopper Pie with Chocolate Wafer Crust.pdf

title: Coffee Almond Fudge Mud Pie with Chocolate Wafer Crust
ingredients: 1 quart coffee or Jamoca Almond Fudge ice cream
directions: Crush cookies in blender and melt 6 tablespoons butter, then press into pie shell.
Bake 10 minutes at 350 degrees Fahrenheit and cool off.
Add ice cream.
Wait till cool and freeze.
Top with chocolate sauce.
pdfLink: Coffee Almond Fudge Mud Pie with Chocolate Wafer Crust.pdf

title: Frozen Oreo Cookie and Cream Ice Cream Pie with Caramel Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 gallon cookie and cream ice cream, divided
Oreo cookie dough or crushed cookies for topping
directions: Mix crushed Oreo cookies together with melted butter.
Press mixture into a pie pan and freeze.
Then add half of the cookie and cream ice cream.
Add 1/2 cup caramel sauce.
Then add the remaining half of the ice cream.
Top with some of Oreo cookie dough and freeze.
notes: Julia Dawson, May 2010
pdfLink: Frozen Oreo Cookie and Cream Ice Cream Pie with Caramel Sauce.pdf

title: Oreo Mudslide Pie with Kahlúa and Baileys
ingredients: Pie crust: 10 ounces crushed Oreo cookies
directions: Mix butter with Oreo cookies. Pack into bottom of greased 10-inch by 2-inch round cake pan.
Bake at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 5 minutes. Cool.
Combine Kahlúa, heavy cream, and butter in saucepan. Bring to boil, remove from heat, add Oreo crumbs, milk chocolate, and 16 ounces (one-half) of whipped topping.
Pour into pie crust and place in freezer for at least 2 hours.
Icing: Combine Baileys, Hershey's chocolate, and remaining Cool Whip; mix.
Remove pie from cake pan. Dip in warm water. Spread icing over entire pie and decorate.
notes: Makes 12 servings.
pdfLink: Oreo Mudslide Pie with Kahlúa and Baileys.pdf

title: Mom Willett's Homemade Butterscotch Pie with Meringue
directions: Mix sugar and flour, add milk slowly.
Cook until thick.
Add egg yolks and cook 3 minutes longer.
Pour into baked pie shell.
Use the 3 egg whites for the meringue (with 1/4 teaspoon of cream of tartar and 1/4 cup sugar, add after egg whites have been beaten and are stiff).
Brown top in oven until golden.
notes: A favorite recipe from Nancy Dawson / Mom Willett's recipe. Happy Eating!!
pdfLink: Mom Willett's Homemade Butterscotch Pie with Meringue.pdf

title: Beryl Willett's Traditional Rhubarb Pie
ingredients: 3 cups cut in 1/2 inch pieces rhubarb
directions: Blend all ingredients, place in unbaked pie shell.
Bake in hot oven 450 degrees for 10 minutes, then 350 degrees for 30 minutes.
notes: A favorite recipe from Nancy Dawson's Mother (Beryl Willett). Makes 1 - 9 inch pie.

title: Classic Fresh Rhubarb Pie with Nutmeg
directions: Mix and pour into unbaked pie shell.
Dot with butter.
Bake in hot oven 450 degrees for 10 minutes, then in 350 degrees about 30 minutes.
pdfLink: Classic Fresh Rhubarb Pie with Nutmeg.pdf

title: Rhubarb and Orange Pie
directions: Line pastry in pie shell and fill with cut up rhubarb.
Mix in bowl and pour over rhubarb.
notes: Shirley Adams 1970

title: Strawberry Angel Pie with Meringue Shell and Whipped Cream
ingredients: 1 cup sliced fresh strawberries or 1 10-ounce package frozen sliced strawberries, thawed and drained
directions: Have egg whites at room temperature.
Add vanilla, cream of tartar, and salt.
Beat until frothy.
Gradually add sugar, a small amount at a time, beating till very stiff peaks form and sugar is dissolved.
Spoon into lightly greased 9-inch pie plate and shape into shell, swirling
pdfLink: Strawberry Angel Pie with Meringue Shell and Whipped Cream.pdf

title: Mrs. Wintle's Lemon Curd Tarts
ingredients: 4 dozen miniature baked tart shells, cooled (recipe below)
directions: Combine lemon rind, lemon juice and sugar in top of double boiler.
Add butter. Heat over boiling water, stirring, until butter is melted.
Stir in eggs.
Continue cooking, stirring constantly, until mixture is thick enough to pile slightly, about 15 minutes.
Cool thoroughly.
Spoon filling into cooled tart shells.
Yield: 4 dozen tarts.

title: Strawberry Ice Cream Pie with Meringue Shell
ingredients: 1 quart low-fat vanilla or strawberry frozen yogurt, sorbet or low-fat ice cream
directions: Pie shell: Place room temperature egg whites in deep bowl of electric mixer; add vanilla, cream of tartar and salt. Beat until soft peaks form. Very gradually add sugar while mixer is running. Continue beating until stiff peaks form. Cover flat baking sheet with brown paper; use a 9-inch cake pan to draw a circle on the brown paper. Use a large spoon to gently spread meringue into circle; form into a shell with 1/2 inch bottom crust and 1 3/4 inch sides. Bake in a preheated oven at 275 degrees for 1 hour. Turn off oven. Do not open door. Leave piecrust in oven for an additional 2 hours. Remove from oven and allow to cool. Piecrust can be stored in a dry location for 1 or 2 days before filling.
Strawberry Sauce: Spoon thawed berries over sliced fresh berries; stir gently. Chill until ready to serve.
To fill: Pile scoops of ice cream into pie shell and top with berries and juice. Serves 6.
notes: The crust sounds harder than it is. Try filling with vanilla ice cream and drizzling with hot fudge sauce!
pdfLink: Strawberry Ice Cream Pie with Meringue Shell.pdf

title: Frozen Strawberry Yogurt Pie with Graham Cracker Crust
directions: Prepare crust and cool completely before filling with yogurt filling. When pie crust is cool, spoon filling into crust and freeze for 4-6 hours or overnight.
FILLING: Gently mix all filling ingredients and chill until ready to use.
EASY GRAHAM CRACKER CRUST: Preheat oven to 375. Combine all crust ingredients, blend well and press on bottom and sides of a 10-inch pie plate. Bake for 10 minutes. Cool completely before filling.

TO SERVE: 20-30 minutes before serving, remove pie from freezer and allow to stand at room temperature until ready to serve. Cut while still slightly frozen, do not allow to thaw completely. Serves 8.
GARNISH: Top each slice with a whole berry and a sprig of mint.
notes: Garnished with fresh berries!
Note: If desired, sliced and sweetened fresh berries can be spooned over each slice.
Both the pie and the crust will become favorites of your light menu!
The use of this material and the words 'Words Worth Eating' is licensed by Jacquelyn G. Legg.
pdfLink: Frozen Strawberry Yogurt Pie with Graham Cracker Crust.pdf

title: Fluffy Strawberry Cream Pie
ingredients: 9-inch Graham Cracker or baked Pastry Crust
directions: Have ready: 9-inch Graham Cracker or baked Pastry Crust
Mix in a 1.5-quart saucepan: 10-ounce package frozen Strawberries, partly thawed, 0.25 cup Water, 0.333 cup Sugar, 0.25 teaspoon Salt, 2 Egg Yolks, 2 teaspoon Lemon Juice
Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a full, all-over boil. Take off heat.
Stir in until dissolved: 1 package Strawberry Gelatin
Chill until mixture is very thick, but not set.
Put into a 1-quart bowl: 2 Egg Whites, 0.5 cup Water, 0.666 cup PET Instant (in dry form)
Whip, with electric beater at high speed or with rotary hand beater, until stiff. Fold whipped mixture into chilled strawberry mixture. Let stand a few minutes, or just until mixture starts to set.
Put into chilled crust. Chill until firm, about 2 hours, or until ready to serve.
notes: Marked as "Very Good"

title: Strawberry Fluff Pie with Graham Cracker Crust
ingredients: 1 pint (1 1/2 pints) fresh strawberries or 12 ounces package frozen strawberries (omit sugar)
Graham Cracker Crust (9 inch pie pan)
directions: Add sugar to strawberries or use frozen strawberries as they are.
Dissolve gelatin in boiling water and chill until it forms a thick syrup (about 15 minutes).
Chill Carnation milk in refrigerator tray until soft ice crystals form through milk (15 to 20 minutes).
Whip milk until stiff (about 1 minute).
Add lemon juice and whip very stiff (about 2 minutes).
Fold whipped Carnation and strawberries into gelatin.
Spoon into crust and chill at least 2 hours or until firm.
pdfLink: Strawberry Fluff Pie with Graham Cracker Crust.pdf

title: Joan Eisele's Creamy Blueberry Pie with Graham Cracker Crust
ingredients: 1/2 to 1 can blueberry pie filling or any other prepared filling
directions: Blend cheese and sugar together until smooth.
Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Pour into crust.
Bake at 350 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes.
Cool and add pie filling and refrigerate until needed.
Garnish with whipped cream.
notes: Recipe by Joan Eisele.
pdfLink: Joan Eisele's Creamy Blueberry Pie with Graham Cracker Crust.pdf

title: Frosty Mint Ice Cream Pies
ingredients: 1 package Pillsbury Plus Devil's Food, Dark Chocolate or Chocolate Mint Cake Mix
3/4 cup Pillsbury Ready To Spread Chocolate Fudge Frosting Supreme
6 cups (1 1/2 quarts) mint chocolate chip or your favorite ice cream, softened
directions: Heat oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit. Generously grease bottom, sides and rim of two 9-inch pie pans or round cake pans.*
In large bowl, blend all shell ingredients at low speed until moistened; beat 2 minutes at highest speed.
Spread half of batter (2 1/4 cups) in bottom of each pan. Do not spread up sides of pan.
Bake at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 25 to 30 minutes; DO NOT OVERBAKE. Cakes will collapse to form shells. Cool completely.
In large bowl, blend ice cream until smooth; spread evenly in center of each shell leaving a 1/2-inch rim.
If desired, heat remaining frosting just until softened.
Drop by spoonfuls on top of ice cream; swirl with knife.
Freeze at least 2 hours. Store in freezer. Wrap frozen pies airtight to avoid freezer burn.
Makes 2 pies. 12 servings.
notes: TIP: *Do not use 8-inch pie or cake pans. HIGH ALTITUDE—Above 3500 Feet: No change.

title: German Sweet Chocolate Pie with Coconut Pecan Crust
ingredients: 1 package (4 ounces) BAKER'S GERMAN'S Sweet Chocolate, melted
directions: Place milk, chocolate, butter, eggs and sugar in electric blender container.
Blend at medium speed for 15 seconds.
Pour into greased 9-inch pie pan, and sprinkle with coconut and pecans.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
Cool.
Store any leftover pie in refrigerator.
notes: Just blend and bake. It even makes its own crust!
pdfLink: German Sweet Chocolate Pie with Coconut Pecan Crust.pdf

title: Blender Coconut Custard Pie
directions: Combine milk, sugar, biscuit mix, eggs, butter and vanilla in electric blender container.
Cover and blend at low speed for 3 minutes.
Pour into greased 9-inch pie pan.
Let stand about 5 minutes; then sprinkle with coconut.
Bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes.
Serve warm or cool.
Store any leftover pie in refrigerator.
notes: Easy and delicious custard pie. Nothing to clean up but the blender.

title: 10-minute German Sweet Chocolate Cream Pie
ingredients: 1 package (4 ounces) BAKER'S® GERMAN'S® Sweet Chocolate*
1 container (8 ounces) BIRDS EYE® COOL WHIP® Non-Dairy Whipped Topping, thawed
notes: Only Baker's® makes German's® Sweet Chocolate. Find it in the baking section of your supermarket.

title: Creamy Chocolate Pie
ingredients: Pinch salt and lump of butter
directions: Mix flour with small amount of milk to form a paste, add egg yolks, chocolate, and salt.
Add remaining milk and cook until thick.
notes: Double for 9" pie. Good. Mom Gilletts

title: Decadent Layered Ginger Snap and Rum Black Bottom Pie
ingredients: 2 teaspoons rum extract (or desired amount to taste)
directions: Pour melted butter over crushed ginger snaps and mix well.
Press down into a 13x9-inch (lasagna) size pan and bake for 10 minutes at 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a saucepan, combine scalded milk, 1 cup sugar, 8 egg yolks, and 2 1/2 tablespoons cornstarch.
Cook until mixture coats a spoon, then remove from heat.
Remove 2 cups of the custard and add 3 squares of melted unsweetened chocolate and 2 tablespoons vanilla. Cool, then pour over the crust.
Into the remaining custard (while still hot), add 2 tablespoons gelatin dissolved in 1/2 cup cold water. Cool well.
Beat 8 egg whites with 1 cup sugar and 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar.
Add 2 teaspoons rum extract (or desired amount to taste) and mix well, then pour over the chocolate layer.
Chill until set.
When ready to serve, top with whipped cream and sprinkle with shaved chocolate.
notes: This triple recipe completely fills a 13x9 (lasagna) size pan.
pdfLink: Decadent Layered Ginger Snap and Rum Black Bottom Pie.pdf

title: Mom Hodge's Rich Egg Custard Pie
directions: Cream 1 stick butter with 1 cup sugar and a pinch of salt.
Beat 5 eggs into mixture.
Add 2 cups milk and 1 teaspoon vanilla.
Pour into 9 inch unbaked pie shell.
Bake in 350 degree oven for 25 minutes or until filling is firm.
notes: I use 1 cup of canned milk and 1 cup of regular milk, that makes it a little richer and more fattening, ha.
pdfLink: Mom Hodge's Rich Egg Custard Pie.pdf

title: Mom Hodge's Classic Southern Buttermilk Pie
directions: Cream sugar and butter well.
Add buttermilk and beat in egg yolks, flour, and flavoring.
Beat egg whites until stiff. Then fold into sugar mixture.
Pour into unbaked pastry lined 9-inch pan.
Sprinkle nutmeg over top.
Bake in preheated 350 degree oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until silver knife comes out clean when inserted in center of filling
pdfLink: Mom Hodge's Classic Southern Buttermilk Pie.pdf

title: Mom Hodge's Creamy Chocolate Almond Icebox Pie
directions: Crush graham crackers and mix well with butter and sugar.
Press into pie pan and bake 8 minutes at 375 degrees.
Melt marshmallows, Hershey bars and 1/2 cup milk in top of double boiler.
Cool this mixture, then fold it into 1/2 cup of cream which has been whipped.
Pour into baked pie crust.
Refrigerate several hours.
Top with remainder of whipped cream and chopped almonds.
Serves 6-8.
notes: Mom Hodge
pdfLink: Mom Hodge's Creamy Chocolate Almond Icebox Pie.pdf

title: Heavenly Chocolate Cream Pie with Graham Cracker Crust
ingredients: 1/4 pound light brown sugar, packed in cup
1/2 cup light brown sugar, firmly packed
directions: Combine ingredients for shell.
Reserve 2 tablespoons for top, press remaining crumbs on bottom and up sides of a 9-inch pie plate and chill.
Melt chocolate over hot water and let cool about 10 minutes.
Blend cheese, first measurement of brown sugar and salt.
Beat in yolks, one at a time, then stir in melted chocolate.
Beat whites until stiff, but not dry.
Beat in remaining brown sugar.
Fold egg white mixture into chocolate mixture with cream and vanilla.
Pour into chilled shell and sprinkle with reserved crumbs.
Chill for several hours before serving.
notes: Shell on back, also.
pdfLink: Heavenly Chocolate Cream Pie with Graham Cracker Crust.pdf

title: Chocolate Marshmallow Delight with Almond Hershey Bars and Graham Cracker Crust
directions: Dissolve in top of double boiler 15 large marshmallows, 1/2 cup whole milk, and 4 5-ounce almond Hershey bars.
Then cool and add 1/2 pint of whipped cream.
Pour in pan on top of graham crackers.
Sprinkle crushed graham crackers over top.
Serves 6.
pdfLink: Chocolate Marshmallow Delight with Almond Hershey Bars and Graham Cracker Crust.pdf

title: Mom Hodge's Pecan and Raisin Nut Tarts
directions: Mix and make dough.
Pinch off and mash with fingers to form pastry shells in small muffin tins.
Mix the filling ingredients and fill tins.
Bake at 325 degrees for 25 minutes.
notes: Mom Hodge 1969
pdfLink: Mom Hodge's Pecan and Raisin Nut Tarts.pdf

title: Decadent Frozen Chocolate Cream Cheese Pie with Graham Cracker Crust
directions: Mix graham cracker crumbs and melted butter, then press into a 9-inch pie plate and chill.
Melt the 6-ounce package of semi-sweet chocolate pieces over hot water and cool.
Stir the softened 3-ounce packages of cream cheese to soften.
Blend in 1/2 cup sugar, 1 teaspoon vanilla, and 1/4 teaspoon salt.
Add 2 egg yolks one at a time, beating well after each, then stir in the melted chocolate.
Chill until thick, then beat smooth.
Whip 1 cup heavy cream and fold into the chocolate mixture.
Beat 2 egg whites to soft peaks, gradually add 1/4 cup sugar, beating to stiff peaks, and fold into the chocolate mixture.
Pile into crust and freeze.
notes: From Jerri Burd
pdfLink: Decadent Frozen Chocolate Cream Cheese Pie with Graham Cracker Crust.pdf

title: Creamy Coconut Custard Pie with Whipped Cream
directions: Combine sugar, cornstarch, and salt, gradually add to milk in saucepan until smooth.
Bring to boiling, stirring over medium heat, heat 2 minutes.
Remove from heat. Stir some of the mixture into egg yolks, then combine and stir in saucepan.
Cook, stirring over low heat until it thickens and is thick enough to mound from spoon.
Then add vanilla, almond, coconut.
Cool. Pour into shell.
Whip cream on top.
notes: Very good
pdfLink: Creamy Coconut Custard Pie with Whipped Cream.pdf

title: Spiced Canned Pumpkin Pie with Single Crust
directions: Mix filling ingredients until smooth.
Place in unbaked pie shell.
Bake in hot oven (425 degrees Fahrenheit) for 15 minutes.
Lower temperature to 350 degrees Fahrenheit and continue baking about 35 minutes or until custard is firm.
notes: Good
pdfLink: Spiced Canned Pumpkin Pie with Single Crust.pdf

title: Spiced Pumpkin Chiffon Pie with Meringue
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon each salt, ginger, nutmeg, and cinnamon
directions: Beat egg yolks with 1/2 cup sugar and pumpkin, milk, and seasoning.
Cook and stir in double boiler until thick.
Add gelatin soaked 5 minutes in water, and stir until gelatin is dissolved.
Cool.
When beginning to thicken, fold in egg whites, beaten until stiff with remaining sugar.
Pour into baked pie shell.
Chill.
Garnish with whipped cream.
pdfLink: Spiced Pumpkin Chiffon Pie with Meringue.pdf

title: Pumpkin Mallow Pie with Gingersnap Crust
directions: Mix ingredients together and place in crust.
Save one container of cool whip for top.
notes: Anne Luther 1986
pdfLink: Pumpkin Mallow Pie with Gingersnap Crust.pdf

title: Southern Chocolate Pecan Pie
ingredients: 1 package (4 ounces) BAKER'S GERMAN'S Sweet Chocolate
directions: Heat chocolate, butter and instant coffee in saucepan over very low heat, stirring constantly until chocolate is melted and mixture is smooth.
Combine sugar and syrup in saucepan.
Bring to a boil over high heat, stirring until sugar is dissolved.
Reduce heat and boil gently for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove from heat; add chocolate mixture.
Pour slowly over eggs, stirring constantly.
Stir in vanilla and nuts.
Pour into pie shell.
Bake at 375 degrees for 45 to 50 minutes, or until filling is completely puffed across top.
Cool.
notes: A luscious indulgence of fine Yankee chocolate and sweet Southern richness.

title: Decadent Chocolate Pecan Tart with Coffee Whipped Cream
ingredients: 1 cup light or dark corn syrup
Coffee Whipped Cream: 1 cup heavy cream, 2 tablespoons 10X (confectioners') sugar, and 1 teaspoon instant coffee
directions: Preheat oven to hot (400°). Prepare piecrust mix following label directions. Roll out to a 13-inch round; fit into a 9-inch tart pan with loose bottom (or fit into a 9-inch pie plate, forming a stand-up fluted edge).
Melt chocolate and butter in a small saucepan over low heat; cool.

Beat eggs slightly in medium-size bowl; blend in sugar and corn syrup. Stir in chocolate-butter mixture and 1 1/3 cups of the pecans. Pour into prepared tart shell. Arrange remaining pecans in a design.

Bake in preheated hot oven (400°) for 5 minutes. Lower oven temperature to moderate (350°); continue baking 35 minutes or until filling is set. Cool completely in pan on wire rack. Remove side of pan. Spoon Coffee Whipped Cream on top just before serving.

COFFEE WHIPPED CREAM: Combine 1 cup heavy cream, 2 tablespoons 10X (confectioners') sugar and 1 teaspoon instant coffee in a medium-size bowl. Beat with electric mixer at high speed until stiff. Refrigerate until ready to use.
notes: Wickedly delicious, divinely chocolate. A tiny sliver is pure bliss! Bake at 400° for 5 minutes, then at 350° for 35 minutes. Makes 12 servings at 57¢ each.
pdfLink: Decadent Chocolate Pecan Tart with Coffee Whipped Cream.pdf

title: Classic Karo Pecan Pie with Variations for Chocolate and Pumpkin
ingredients: 1 cup KARO light or dark corn syrup
directions: Stir together first 5 ingredients until blended.
Add nuts.
Pour into pastry shell.
Bake in 350°F oven 50 to 60 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean.
Cool.
notes: Chocolate Pecan Pie: Decrease sugar to 1/3 cup. Add 4 ounces melted semisweet chocolate. Pumpkin Pecan Pie: Pumpkin Layer - Stir together 1 egg, 1 cup canned pumpkin, 1/3 cup sugar, 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon, 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger and 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves until blended. Spread evenly in bottom of unbaked (9") pastry shell. Pecan Layer - Stir together 2 eggs, 2/3 cup corn syrup, 2/3 cup sugar, 2 tablespoon melted margarine and 1/2 teaspoon vanilla. Add 1 cup pecans. Carefully spoon over pumpkin layer. Bake in 350°F oven 60 minutes or until filling is set around edges.
pdfLink: Classic Karo Pecan Pie with Variations for Chocolate and Pumpkin.pdf

title: Leela's Classic Southern Pecan Pie
directions: Line bottom of uncooked pie shell with pecans.
Pour in mixture.
Bake at 425 degrees for 10 minutes, then 350 degrees for 35 minutes.

title: Classic Southern Pecan Pie
directions: Combine sugar, syrup, and melted butter.
Add beaten eggs and pecans.
Mix thoroughly.
Bake 40 to 45 minutes in oven at 375 degrees.
notes: Excellent. '57 Mrs. Hodges

title: Grandmother's Rich Fudge Pie with Vanilla Ice Cream
ingredients: 1-quart vanilla ice cream, regular or low fat
directions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.
Melt butter and chocolate and cool slightly.
Gradually blend chocolate and eggs.
Add rest of ingredients except ice cream and stir until just mixed.
Spread into a buttered 9-inch pie plate and bake precisely 40 minutes.
Serves 6-8.
notes: The center firms as it cools. Top with vanilla ice cream while warm and enjoy!
pdfLink: Grandmother's Rich Fudge Pie with Vanilla Ice Cream.pdf

title: Decadent Chocolate Walnut Meringue Brownie Pie
directions: Beat egg whites and salt until soft peaks form.
Gradually add sugar, beating until soft peaks form.
Fold in crumbs, nuts, and vanilla.
Spread evenly in lightly buttered 9-inch pie plate.
Bake in slow oven (325 degrees) about 35 minutes.
Cool thoroughly.
Spread top with whipped cream.
Chill well 3 to 4 hours.
notes: Recipe by M. K. Long
pdfLink: Decadent Chocolate Walnut Meringue Brownie Pie.pdf

title: Carolyn's Million Dollar Pineapple Pecan Icebox Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients except nuts.
Put into 2 graham cracker crusts.
Sprinkle nuts on top.
Refrigerate or freeze.
pdfLink: Carolyn's Million Dollar Pineapple Pecan Icebox Pie.pdf

title: Frozen Lemonade and Pineapple Cream Pie
directions: Mix ingredients together.
Pour into a graham cracker crust.
Freeze.
pdfLink: Frozen Lemonade and Pineapple Cream Pie.pdf

title: Amazing Coconut Impossible Pie
directions: Combine milk, sugar, biscuit mix, eggs, butter and vanilla in electric blender container.
Cover and blend on low speed for 3 minutes.
Pour into greased 9-inch pie pan.
Let stand about 5 minutes; then sprinkle with coconut.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Serve warm or cool.
notes: Some people call it the Impossible Pie because it even makes its own crust. Just mix, bake and serve.

title: Chocolate Swirl Cheesecake Pie
ingredients: 3 packages (8 ounces each) cream cheese, softened
1 package BAKER'S GERMAN'S Sweet Chocolate, melted and cooled
directions: Add sugar to cheese in a bowl, beating well.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Add vanilla.
Measure 2 cups of the cheese mixture; fold in chocolate.
Pour remaining cheese mixture into a well-buttered 10-inch pie pan or 9-inch square pan.
Add spoonfuls of the chocolate cheese mixture and zigzag a spatula through batter to marble.
Bake at 350 degrees for 40 to 45 minutes.
Cool; then chill.
Cut in wedges.
notes: Makes 12 servings. See other side.

title: Intriguing All-around Kahlua Pie with Fluted Crust and Cream Topping
directions: EARLY ON SERVING DAY: Make up favorite packaged piecrust mix as label directs for a 2-crust pie. Roll out half of piecrust and fit into an 8-inch glass pie plate, using scissors to trim edge even with pie-plate edge; secure to rim with little egg white. Roll out other half of piecrust, then, with sharp knife, cut it into strips about 1/2 inch wide.

Brush top edge of pie shell with egg white, then fasten one end of a pastry strip to edge. Holding end of pencil at right angle to pan edge, make loop by lifting strip over pencil; remove pencil; then press strip with side of pencil to seal loop in upright position. Repeat, all around edge of pie shell, as pictured, using additional strips as needed. Refrigerate.
Start heating oven to 450 degrees Fahrenheit. Using a 4-tined fork, prick pie shell well, then bake 12 to 15 minutes or till golden. Peek after 5 minutes; if bubbles appear, prick again. Cool.

Meanwhile, in double-boiler top, combine 4.5 teaspoons unflavored gelatin and 1/3 cup granulated sugar; add 4 egg yolks and beat slightly; now stir 3/4 cup Kahlua (coffee-flavor liqueur). Cook over boiling water, stirring constantly, until thickened;
Now, in large bowl, beat 4 egg whites until frothy; then add 1/4 teaspoon salt; beat until soft peaks form. Now gradually beat in 1/4 cup granulated sugar.

Whip 1 cup heavy or whipping cream until stiff; place on top of egg whites; then top with cooled Kahlua mixture, and gently fold mixtures together. Refrigerate until mixture holds a definite mound shape when dropped from a spoon; then pile lightly in shell. Refrigerate.

ABOUT THIRTY MINUTES BEFORE SERVING: Whip 1/4 cup heavy or whipping cream and drop, by rounded tablespoonfuls, onto top of pie, as pictured. Sprinkle with shaved unsweetened chocolate. Refrigerate; serve in 8 wedges.
notes: Recipe by Virginia V. Voboril
pdfLink: Intriguing All-Around Kahlua Pie with Fluted Crust and Cream Topping.pdf

title: Ritz Cracker and Pecan Pie with Whipped Cream
directions: Roll crackers fine - add 0.5 of sugar - nuts and vanilla.
Beat egg whites until they peak.
Add rest of sugar then crackers, nuts and sugar - fold in - pour into well buttered 9 inch pie plate.
Bake at 350 degrees - 25 to 35 minutes - cool.
Spread with whipped cream and coconut on top. Chill at least 3 hours.
notes: Recipe from the kitchen of Nancy Hodge. Serves 8.
pdfLink: Ritz Cracker and Pecan Pie with Whipped Cream.pdf

title: Sheila Mathey's Holiday Pecan Pie
directions: In a bowl with an electric mixer beat the whites until they just hold stiff peaks and fold in the crumbs, the sugar, the baking powder, the vanilla, and the pecans.
Pour the batter into a buttered 9-inch pie plate and bake the pie in the middle of a preheated 350° F. oven for 25 to 30 minutes, or until it is puffed and golden.
Let the pie cool and serve it with the whipped cream.
notes: My mother made this pecan pie every Thanksgiving and Christmas. It is simple and delicious—and different from the classic recipe. We still enjoy it at holidays and hope you will too. — Elizabeth Mathey Landry, Yonkers, New York

title: Creamy Cherry-glazed Cheesecake Pie with Graham Cracker Crust
ingredients: 1 can (1 pound, 4 ounces) tart red cherries, packed in water
directions: To prepare the crust: Combine 1 1/4 cups graham-cracker crumbs, 1/4 cup butter or margarine, 1/4 cup sugar, and 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon in a medium bowl; blend with fingers, fork, or pastry blender.
Press the crust mixture evenly on the bottom and sides of a 9-inch pie plate (not on the rim). Refrigerate.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, using a wooden spoon, beat the cream cheese until light.
Gradually add 1/2 cup sugar, beating until the mixture is smooth.
Add flour and eggs; beat thoroughly.
Add milk and vanilla extract, beating until well combined.
Pour the filling into the prepared pie shell; bake for 40 minutes, or until firm in the center and lightly browned. Let cool on a wire rack.
Meanwhile, make the Cherry Glaze: Drain the cherries, reserving 1 cup of the liquid.
Combine 1/4 cup sugar and cornstarch in a small saucepan. Stir in the reserved cherry liquid; bring to boiling, and boil, stirring constantly, until thickened and translucent.
Add almond extract and a few drops of red food color; refrigerate until cold.
Add the cherries to the glaze, and spread over the cooled pie. Refrigerate until serving time.
Makes 8 servings.
Note regarding crust: To make the crumbs, use a rolling pin to roll 14 graham crackers between 2 sheets of waxed paper to make fine, even crumbs, measuring 1 1/4 cups.
notes: The crust recipe uses 14 graham crackers to achieve the required 1 1/4 cups of crumbs.
pdfLink: Creamy Cherry-Glazed Cheesecake Pie with Graham Cracker Crust.pdf

title: Frosted Chocolate Coconut Cookies
directions: Melt chocolate and butter in saucepan over low heat; cool.
Combine biscuit mix and sugar.
Stir in egg, milk, chocolate mixture and vanilla; blend well.
Fold in coconut and drop from a teaspoon onto ungreased baking sheets.
Bake at 375 degrees for 12 to 14 minutes.
Cool on rack.
Spread with chocolate or vanilla butter cream frosting and decorate, if desired.
Makes about 4 dozen.

title: Fresh Strawberry Cheesecake Pie with Gelatin Glaze
ingredients: 1 9-inch baked pastry shell with high fluted edge, cooled
directions: Prepare cheesecake mix according to package directions; stir in almonds.
Pour into baked pastry shell; chill 1 hour.
Meanwhile, in saucepan, combine sugar and cornstarch.
Mash 1 cup of the strawberries; add water to make 2 cups.
Stir into sugar mixture.
Cook and stir to boiling; boil 2 minutes.
Remove from heat; strain.
Add gelatin, butter or margarine and lemon juice; stir till gelatin dissolves.
Chill till partially set.
Spoon 1 1/2 cups of the gelatin mixture over cheesecake mixture.
Arrange remaining strawberries, pointed end up, over pie.
Carefully spoon remaining gelatin mixture over berries, being careful not to overflow pastry edges.
Chill till set.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.
notes: That luscious cheesecake pie on our cover is much easier to make than it looks. You start with a no-bake cheesecake mix and top it with best-of-the-season strawberries in a shimmering gelatin glaze. Use the graham cracker crumb crust from the mix instead of the pastry crust, if you like.
pdfLink: Fresh Strawberry Cheesecake Pie with Gelatin Glaze.pdf

title: Bourbon and Soy Sauce Marinated Flank Steak
directions: Place flank steaks in cake pan long style, add soy sauce and bourbon to cover about 1/2 of steak.
Turn once or twice.
Leave in mixture at least 8 hours or overnight.
Dash of garlic salt over steaks.
Grill on charcoal.
notes: Marked as "Very Good", Ft. Bliss Oct 1962. 2 flank steaks - 6 servings, 3 flank steaks - 8 servings.
pdfLink: Bourbon and Soy Sauce Marinated Flank Steak.pdf

title: Blue Cheese and Garlic Stuffed Flank Steak
ingredients: 1 clove of garlic put through press
directions: Sprinkle both sides of one flank steak with tenderizer.
Pierce meat with a fork about every inch.
Let stand at room temperature for 30 to 40 minutes.
Cream together cheese and garlic.
Spread one side of meat with cheese mixture.
Roll up starting with long side and tie with string at 1-inch intervals.
Slice between the strings.
Brush with Italian dressing and barbecue over coals or oven broil.
Brush with dressing periodically.
notes: Marked as "Good"
pdfLink: Blue Cheese and Garlic Stuffed Flank Steak.pdf

title: Herbed Beef Strip Steaks with Parmesan and Fresh Herbs
ingredients: 2 Ukrop's Own Beef Beef Loin Boneless Strip Steaks, 1" thick
2 slices Parmesan cheese or 1/4 cup fresh grated
directions: In a bowl, mix together garlic, rosemary, basil, salt and pepper; spread evenly on both sides of steaks.
Grill over medium high coals 4 to 5 inches from heat for 5 to 7 minutes per side or until desired degree of doneness.
Top with cheese the last minute of grilling time; plate and garnish with parsley.
Serves 2.
notes: Serve with grilled garlic bread.
pdfLink: Herbed Beef Strip Steaks with Parmesan and Fresh Herbs.pdf

title: Marinated Flank Steak with Tangy Soy-vinegar Glaze
directions: In blender, combine everything but meat and whirl to mix.
Place meat in plastic bag with zipper closing and pour one half of the marinade over it.
Put bag into flat bowl and refrigerate from 12 to 24 hours, turning bag occasionally.
Barbecue steak on outdoor grill about 4 to 6 minutes on each side. It should be pink in the middle.
The rest of the marinade will keep in the refrigerator for several months.
Be sure to cut the meat into thin, diagonal slices.
notes: Joan B. Dishman. Handwritten note at top: 'This one is our favorite.' and '1/2 the recipe'.
pdfLink: Marinated Flank Steak with Tangy Soy-Vinegar Glaze.pdf

title: California London Broil with Teriyaki Marinade
ingredients: 1 1/2-2 pounds London Broil, cut approximately 1 1/4-1 1/2 inches thick
directions: Place London Broil in a 9 x 13 glass dish.
Blend marinade ingredients and pour over meat; cover with plastic wrap and allow to marinate overnight in the refrigerator.
Grill over a hot charcoal fire or gas grill.
Cook approximately 5-7 minutes per side, depending on thickness of meat.
DO NOT OVERCOOK!
Slice on the diagonal in thin slices.
Serves 8.
notes: Serve with oven-roasted potatoes and sautéed, lemon asparagus! The use of this material and the words 'Words Worth Eating' is licensed by Jacquelyn G. Legg.
pdfLink: California London Broil with Teriyaki Marinade.pdf

title: Herb Crusted Flank Steak with Dijon and Whole Wheat Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 1 pound flank steak, visible fat removed
directions: Preheat broiler and pan.
Combine salt, tarragon, garlic, pepper and dijon mustard in small bowl.
Spread half of mixture on one side of meat.
Broil steak for 4 minutes, mustard mixture side up, about 4 inches from the heat.
Turn meat over and spread with other half of mixture.
Broil an additional 3 minutes.
Combine bread crumbs and parsley.
Pat evenly on meat.
Broil 1 additional minute.
Let stand for 5 minutes.
Slice steak thin diagonally across grain.
pdfLink: Herb Crusted Flank Steak with Dijon and Whole Wheat Bread Crumbs.pdf

title: Stuffed Flank Steak Tournedos with Bacon and Hollandaise
ingredients: Pound flank steak to even thickness about 1/2 inch thick. Use meat tenderizer
directions: Cook bacon until almost done, but not crisp. Sprinkle flank steak with garlic salt and pepper. Score steak diagonally making diamond-shaped cuts.
Place bacon strips lengthwise on flank steak. Sprinkle with parsley.
Roll up jelly roll fashion, start with narrow end. Skewer with wooden picks at 1 inch intervals. Cut 1 inch slices.
Grill over coals 15 minutes, turning often, for rare.
Sauce according to package directions. Add tarragon. Serve over steaks.
notes: 4 servings @ 2 pinwheels
pdfLink: Stuffed Flank Steak Tournedos with Bacon and Hollandaise.pdf

title: Marinated Roast Eye of Round Beef in Red Wine Sauce
directions: Day before: Wipe roast with damp paper towels. Make slits, oven deep, across top of meat. Insert a sliver of garlic into each slit.
Rub entire surface of meat with 1 teaspoon salt, 1/2 teaspoon pepper, and thyme. Place meat in shallow baking dish.
Make Marinade: In small bowl, combine dressing, 1 cup wine, and bay leaf. Pour over meat. Cover well with saran wrap. Refrigerate overnight; turn the meat once or twice.
Next day: Preheat oven to 450 degrees Fahrenheit.
Place roast in shallow roasting pan. Insert meat thermometer into thickest part. Reserve marinade.
Roast 25 minutes. Pour marinade over roast; roast 25 minutes longer, or until meat thermometer registers 140 degrees Fahrenheit for rare; or 35 minutes to 160 degrees Fahrenheit for medium rare.
pdfLink: Marinated Roast Eye of Round Beef in Red Wine Sauce.pdf

title: Slow Cooker French Dip Sandwiches with Tender Eye of Round Roast
ingredients: 1 (3 1/2 to 4 pound) eye of round roast
directions: Place roast in crockpot.
Combine soy sauce and next 6 ingredients - pour over roast.
Add water until roast is almost covered.
Cook covered on low 7 hours or until tender.
Remove roast - reserving broth.
Shred roast with a fork.
Serve with reserved broth.
notes: Sue Damper
pdfLink: Slow Cooker French Dip Sandwiches with Tender Eye of Round Roast.pdf

title: Tenderloin of Beef in Herb Wreath
ingredients: 1 filet of beef, ready to cook (have butcher tie beef and include a layer of fat on the side)
2 large cloves of garlic, cut into slivers
2 bunches fresh rosemary (reserve 4 sprigs for garnish)
2 bunches fresh sage (reserve 1/2 bunch for garnish)
directions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
With the tip of a sharp knife, cut slits in the filet and insert garlic slivers in the slits.
Rub filet all over with black pepper and thyme.
Lay sprigs of rosemary and sage on top of and around filet and carefully tie in place with kitchen string.
Place thin sheet of fat on top of herbs and sprinkle with salt. Place filet in a shallow roasting pan.
Bake filet for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350°F and bake an additional 20-25 minutes for rare meat or 35 minutes for medium rare. Remove fat layer and herbs.
Place on a large attractive platter garnished with reserved rosemary and sage. Carve into 1-inch-thick slices. Serves 8
pdfLink: Tenderloin of Beef in Herb Wreath.pdf

title: Elegant Filet Mignon with Savory Shallot and Butter Sauce
ingredients: 2 to 3 teaspoons freshly cracked black pepper or 2 to 3 teaspoons Spice Islands fine or medium grind black pepper
3 to 6 whole shallots, sliced in half
directions: Dry filets and sprinkle each side generously with 1/2 teaspoon pepper; press pepper into beef.
Place on plate and cover; refrigerate 2 to 3 hours.
In a skillet, heat olive oil and add 1 tablespoon butter; cook quickly on each side (approximately 4 to 6 minutes per side).
Place meat on a warm platter; keep warm.
Pour pan drippings from skillet and add 2 to 3 tablespoons butter.
Sauté shallots for one minute over medium heat; add beef bouillon.
Increase heat and boil to reduce pan juices to 2 tablespoons.
Be sure to scrape bottom of pan well while sauce is cooking; add red wine vinegar and Worcestershire sauce; boil one minute.
Add remaining 2 to 3 tablespoons butter and mix with pan juices; pour over filets.
Garnish with sliced green onions.
Serve immediately.
Serves 4.
notes: Sliced mushrooms can be substituted for shallots. Use only the best grade of extra-virgin olive oil for this recipe. "Do not overcook this elegant beef dish!" The use of this material and the words 'Words Worth Eating' is licensed by Jacquelyn G. Legg.
pdfLink: Elegant Filet Mignon with Savory Shallot and Butter Sauce.pdf

title: Roasted Beef Tenderloin with Mushroom Sherry Sauce
directions: Spread 4 tablespoons butter on roast.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Bake 10 to 15 minutes at 450 degrees Fahrenheit.
While baking, prepare the sauce: melt 4 tablespoons butter and add fresh mushrooms, green onions, and minced garlic to sautéd mixture.
Add soy sauce, dijon mustard, 0.5 teaspoon pepper, and dry sherry.
Bring to boil and pour over roast.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
notes: Laura Gough, December 1991, Excellent
pdfLink: Roasted Beef Tenderloin with Mushroom Sherry Sauce.pdf

title: Entrecote Au Paivre Et Roquefort (peppered Steak with Roquefort Cheese)
ingredients: 2 New York strip steaks, 12 ounces each
directions: Steak: Preheat the broiler. Lightly salt the steaks.
Combine the peppercorns and coriander. Using the heel of your hand, firmly press the mixture into both sides of each steak.

Heat the butter and oil in a heavy skillet. When the butter begins to brown, add the steaks and cook over moderately high heat until they are browned on both sides. Allow 3 minutes per side for medium rare.
Remove steaks and place on a platter, keeping them warm while you prepare the sauce.

Sauce: Wipe out the saucepan in which the steaks were prepared. Then put in the shallots, peppercorns and wine and place over high heat. Let the mixture reduce until it is almost dry. Add the beef broth and bring to a boil. Remove from the heat and stir in the butter with a whisk. Add the garlic and lemon juice. Taste and adjust seasonings.
When ready to serve, place 1 tablespoon of cheese, broken into 4 or 5 pieces, on top of each steak.
Place the steaks under the broiler until the cheese begins to melt. Remove the steaks from the broiler and pour the sauce around them. Serve at once.
notes: Recipe supplied by restaurant; tested by members of the junior element of the Tidewater Chef's Association, American Culinary Federation and Johnson and Wales University College of Culinary Arts
pdfLink: Entrecote au Paivre et Roquefort (Peppered Steak with Roquefort Cheese).pdf

title: Manakins's Ground Beef Barbecue
directions: Brown meat, add rest of ingredients.
Simmer 3 hours.
notes: Yields about 10 barbecues.

title: St. Louis Beef Barbecue with Vegetables and Chili Sauce
directions: Brown the meat, add vegetables, and simmer for 20 minutes.
notes: Written on phone-themed stationery from St. Louis with a side note about cookies.
pdfLink: St. Louis Beef Barbecue with Vegetables and Chili Sauce.pdf

title: Stir-fried Steak and Vegetable Sandwiches with Provolone
ingredients: 1 pound beef round tip steaks, cut 1/8 to 1/4-inch thick
1 medium zucchini, cut into 1/4-inch thick slices
1 medium red bell pepper, cut into thin strips
4 crusty hoagie rolls (approximately 6 inches long each), split
directions: Stack beef steaks; cut lengthwise in half, then crosswise into 1-inch wide strips. Set aside.

In large nonstick skillet, heat 2 teaspoons oil over medium-high heat until hot. Add zucchini, onion, bell pepper and Italian seasoning. Stir-fry 3 to 4 minutes or until crisp-tender. Remove from skillet.

In same skillet, heat 1 teaspoon oil until hot. Stir-fry beef in 2 batches, 1 to 2 minutes each or until outside surface is no longer pink. (Do not overcook.) Return beef to skillet. Season with salt and pepper. Stir in zucchini mixture; heat through.

Arrange 1/4 of beef mixture on bottom of each roll; top each with 1 cheese slice. Place on rack in broiler pan so surface of cheese is 4 inches from heat. Broil 1 to 2 minutes or until cheese is melted. Close sandwiches.
Yield: 4 servings
pdfLink: Stir-Fried Steak and Vegetable Sandwiches with Provolone.pdf

title: Curried Beef Hamburgers with Homemade Curry Sauce
ingredients: 3 slices fresh ginger, shredded (for curry sauce)
directions: Mix all hamburger ingredients well and form into 4 patties.
Broil 3 inches from fire for 4 to 6 minutes.
Serve with curry sauce (see separate recipe or continuation on page 2).
For Curry Sauce: Melt butter; add onion, garlic, and ginger. Fry until golden brown.
Add curry powder and sugar, mix well. Add flour and mix.
Add stock and cook, stirring constantly until thick.
notes: Good with fish and chicken also.
pdfLink: Curried Beef Hamburgers with Homemade Curry Sauce.pdf

title: Stuffed Italian Hamburgers with Mozzarella
directions: Mix all ingredients except mozzarella thoroughly.
Form into 8 patties.
Place slice of mozzarella on each of 4 patties.
Cover with remaining 4 patties and press edges to seal the cheese in well.
Grill 3 inches from firebed about 4 to 6 minutes on each side.
Serves 4.
notes: Marked as "Very Good" - Jerri

title: Sarah Beda's Spiced Charcoal Grilled Beef Burgers with Vermouth Catsup Basting Sauce
ingredients: 1 piece of candied ginger (size of a quarter), minced very fine
1/4 cup dry vermouth (sweet if you prefer)
directions: Mix together the ground beef, egg, onion, candied ginger, cinnamon, powdered coffee, oregano, and sweet basil, and form into thick patties.
Prepare a sauce made of catsup, soy sauce, dry vermouth, and cooking oil.
Broil over charcoal, basting with the prepared sauce.
pdfLink: Sarah Beda's Spiced Charcoal Grilled Beef Burgers with Vermouth Catsup Basting Sauce.pdf

title: California Dried Beef and Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 cup green peppers or ripe olives, chopped
directions: Pour into greased casserole and bake at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 25 minutes.
notes: Serves 6. Contributed by Jerri Burd.
pdfLink: California Dried Beef and Noodle Casserole.pdf

title: Dried Beef and Sour Cream with Mushrooms
directions: Cut beef into strips and melt butter in pan.
Add beef and onion and cook until onion is transparent.
Blend in flour and add milk.
Stir constantly.
Cook until smooth and thick.
Then add sour cream, mushrooms, and parsley and blend.
Season to taste and heat.
notes: Serves about 4.
pdfLink: Dried Beef and Sour Cream with Mushrooms.pdf

title: Savory Bacon-topped Meatloaf with Olives and Vegetables
directions: Beat egg, add mustard, catsup, onion, olives, salt and pepper.
Add meat; mix well.
Line bottom of loaf pan (9 x 5 x 2) with bacon strips. Then place the pepper rings and tomato slices.
Pack meat mixture on top.
Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour 15 minutes.
Turn upside down to serve.
(When loaf is half done, pour off grease and then again before turning on serving platter)
notes: Good Jerri
pdfLink: Savory Bacon-Topped Meatloaf with Olives and Vegetables.pdf

title: Mary Kay Long's Cheesy Hamburger Loaf on French Bread
directions: Spread on French bread cut long
Wrap in foil
Bake 25 minutes at 350 degrees
notes: Recipe by Mary Kay Long.
pdfLink: Mary Kay Long's Cheesy Hamburger Loaf on French Bread.pdf

title: Mrs. Grout's Zesty Horseradish Meatloaf
directions: Mix all ingredients, except catsup.
Pack in loaf pan and pour catsup over top.
notes: Serves 16

title: Seared Flank Steak with Lime-wasabi Sauce
directions: Place steaks and marinade in a 2-gallon zip-top plastic freezer bag; seal bag, and turn to coat. Chill 2 to 12 hours.
Preheat grill to 400° to 450° (high) heat. Grill steak, covered with grill lid, 5 to 7 minutes on each side or to desired degree of doneness. Remove from grill, and let stand 10 minutes.
notes: Zesty red wine marinade is the key for this super-tender and deeply flavored steak. The longer it marinates, the better.
pdfLink: Seared Flank Steak with Lime-Wasabi Sauce.pdf

title: Ukrop's Grilled Top Round London Broil with Tangy Mustard Marinade
ingredients: 1 top round London Broil, approximately 2-inches thick
directions: To prepare the marinade, combine all marinade ingredients and whisk to incorporate.
Place the London broil in a large glass or non-reactive dish.
Cover with half of the marinade (Reserve remaining marinade for later use; store refrigerated for 7-10 days).
Cover and refrigerate in marinade for 30 minutes.
Preheat an outdoor grill on high.
Remove the steak from marinade and pat dry with paper towels.
Grill over hottest part of the grill for 4-5 minutes.
Turn and reduce heat to low.
Move steak to indirect heat and continue cooking on low for 12-15 minutes or to desired doneness. Medium rare internal temperature should read 130-140 degrees.
Serve with grilled vegetables and fresh corn on the cob.
notes: Serves 4.
pdfLink: Ukrop's Grilled Top Round London Broil with Tangy Mustard Marinade.pdf

title: Grilled Teriyaki Sirloin Steak
ingredients: 1-2 tablespoons green onions including tops, chopped (optional)
directions: Trim fat from steak.
Combine soy sauce, water, sugar, garlic powder and ginger.
Place steak in marinade for 1 1/2-2 hours; refrigerate while marinating.
Turn twice while marinating.
Grill over HOT coals.
For a medium-rare steak grill 5-7 minutes on each side.
Do not overcook!
Remove from grill and slice in thin slices.
Combine butter and green onions; serve with hot steak and top with a sprinkling of cracked pepper.
Serves 4-8 depending on the thickness of the steak.
notes: For thicker steaks, adjust cooking time. This recipe works just as well on a gas grill. Adjust cooking time as necessary for a gas grill. "Serve with a green salad and baked potatoes for an elegant and easy meal!"

title: Garlic, Roasted Red Pepper, and Kalamata Olive Butter Topping for Chicken or Fish
ingredients: 1 cup roasted red peppers, thin strips
directions: Saute butter and garlic, then add rest of ingredients.
Heat through, serve over fish or chicken.
notes: Marked as "Very Good"
pdfLink: Garlic, Roasted Red Pepper, and Kalamata Olive Butter Topping for Chicken or Fish.pdf

title: Oven-baked Beef Stew
directions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.
Cut beef into 3/4 - 1-inch cubes; set aside.
Combine flour, salt, pepper and paprika; toss beef cubes in flour mixture; set aside.
Pour oil in a heavy, covered ovenproof casserole; heat in oven.
When oil is hot, add beef cubes and toss in oil.
Bake uncovered for 30 minutes.
Remove from oven, add all remaining ingredients, cover and cook an additional 1 1/2 - 1 3/4 hours at 350 degrees or until fork tender.
Yields 6 servings.
Garnish with minced parsley and enjoy!
notes: A wonderful old-fashioned dinner for family and friends! ...from our collection of family favorites. The use of this material and the words 'Words Worth Eating' is licensed by Jacquelyn G. Legg.

title: Hearty Beef and Vegetable Stew with Pearl Onions and Sugar Snap Peas
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds Ukrop's Own Beef Eye Round Roast
2 tablespoons cornstarch, dissolved in 2 tablespoons water
directions: Trim any fat from beef and cut into 1 inch pieces.
In Dutch oven, heat oil over medium-high heat until hot.
Add beef (half at a time) and brown evenly, stirring occasionally.
Pour off drippings.
Season with thyme, salt and pepper.
Stir in broth, cooking wine and garlic.
Bring to a boil; reduce heat to low.
Cover tightly and simmer 1 1/2 hours.
Add carrots and onions.
Cover and continue cooking 35 to 40 minutes or until beef and vegetables are tender.
Bring beef stew to a boil over medium-high heat.
Add cornstarch mixture while stirring, cook and stir 1 minute.
Stir in sugar snap peas.
Reduce heat to medium and cook 3 to 4 minutes or until peas are heated through.
notes: Serve with European Crusty Bread From Ukrop's Bakery. Adapted from Texas Beef Council by Ukrop's. Make double for a crowd.
pdfLink: Hearty Beef and Vegetable Stew with Pearl Onions and Sugar Snap Peas.pdf

title: Prime Beef Stroganoff with Cream of Mushroom and Sherry
directions: Mix altogether in casserole.
Cover and bake 3 hours at 325 degrees.
Serve over noodles or rice.
notes: Works just as well in a crock-pot also!
pdfLink: Prime Beef Stroganoff with Cream of Mushroom and Sherry.pdf

title: Sicilian-style Braised Pot Roast with Olives and Tomatoes
ingredients: Grated peel and juice of 1 lemon
1/2 cup kalamata olives, pitted and chopped
1 Morton's of Omaha Beef Pot Roast (2 to 3 pounds)
directions: Preheat oven to 325°F.

In a heavy sauté pan, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add red pepper flakes and garlic to the sauté pan; cook until the aroma is apparent. Add wine and simmer until the liquid is reduced by half. Add tomato sauce, grated lemon peel and olives; bring to a simmer.
Place the pot roast in the sauce, cover the pan and gently heat until an internal temperature of 150°F is reached (approximately 30 minutes).
Add lemon juice and chopped parsley to the sauce and check for seasoning.
Serve with polenta, broccoli and crusty bread. Makes 4 servings.
notes: Recipe appears in Costco's latest cookbook, Creative Cooking The Costco Way. Can be found at costco.com, under 'Costco Cookbook.'
pdfLink: Sicilian-Style Braised Pot Roast with Olives and Tomatoes.pdf

title: Beef Stew with Chestnuts
ingredients: 3 pounds boneless stewing beef, cut into 4 pieces
Salt and freshly ground pepper, to taste
directions: Rub the meat with salt and pepper.
In a heavy, flameproof casserole dish over medium-high heat, warm 2 tablespoons oil until hot.
Add meat (be sure not to overcrowd the pot) and sear, without moving, until well-browned, 2–3 minutes per side.
Remove from casserole dish.
Add 1 tablespoon oil and add the onion, garlic, bay leaves, star anise, carrots and celery and sauté, stirring occasionally scraping up any browned bits, until tender and browned, 5–7 minutes.
Add salt and pepper, stir in the tomato puree, and cook, 1 minute more.
Add the wine and 1¼ cups water, bring to a boil, then simmer until reduced by half, 30–40 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to 300°F.
Return the meat to the casserole dish with the vegetable-wine mixture, cover and braise in the oven until the meat is tender and nearly falling apart, about 3 hours.
If using fresh chestnuts, slice the chestnut skins open on their curved side, then boil for 5 minutes.
Strain, cool, then peel and remove the brown pith.
Cut in half.
In a skillet over medium heat, warm the remaining ½ tablespoon oil.
Add the sugar and chestnuts, and sauté until caramelized, about 3 minutes.
Add to the casserole dish, then return to the oven to braise for 40 minutes more.
Serves 6.
notes: Adapted from Fresh from the Farmer’s Market: Fall by Alistair Hendy (Ryland, Peeters & Small, 1999). Williams-Sonoma, Inc., 1999.

title: Hot and Spicy Slow Cooker Beef Stew with Olives and Salsa
ingredients: 3 pounds beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes
2 medium potatoes, cut into 1/2 inch pieces
1 6-ounce can small pitted ripe olives, undrained
directions: Combine all ingredients, except cornstarch and water, in slow cooking pot. Stir well to blend.
Cover and cook at desired cooking time, or until vegetables are tender.
Increase heat to high. Combine cornstarch and water. Stir slowly into stew mixture until thickened. Reduce heat until serving time.
Serve with nacho chips and salad
notes: From Geri. Makes 6 servings, plus. Slow cooker: 7 to 9 hours on low, 3 to 4 hours on high.
pdfLink: Hot and Spicy Slow Cooker Beef Stew with Olives and Salsa.pdf

title: Grilled Filets Mignon with Green Chile Rub
ingredients: 2-4 tablespoons minced green chiles, such a poblano, Serrano, jalapeno or a combination (seeds removed)
4 filets mignon approximately 1-inch thick (trimmed very well)
directions: Combine the first 7 ingredients in a food processor fitted with a metal blade and pulse until the mixture is the consistency of rough paste.
Rub both sides of each filet with paste; place in a glass dish, cover.
Refrigerate overnight.
To Grill: Preheat grill to medium hot.
Grill the steaks 5 inches above a medium hot fire for 3-6 minutes on each side depending on thickness of filets.
The outside of the steaks will be brown and crusty. (Do not allow to get too dark.)
Remove from grill and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Note: If cooking longer than the suggested time, reduce heat of fire.
"Serve with cheese grits and a green salad!"
notes: From our collection of family favorites. The use of this material and the words 'Words Worth Eating' is licensed by Jacquelyn G. Legg.
pdfLink: Grilled Filets Mignon with Green Chile Rub.pdf

title: Beef Enchiladas with Green Chilies and Cheddar Cheese
ingredients: 2 4-ounce cans Old El Paso peeled green chilies, drained
2-3 teaspoons chopped green onions, including tops
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Combine ground beef, salt, pepper, green chilies, onion, and garlic.
Cook over medium heat until beef is browned and onion is tender.
Drain well and set aside.
Pour half of tomato sauce in a lightly greased 9 x 13 baking dish; sprinkle with oregano.
Spoon 3-4 tablespoons of beef mixture on each tortilla; top with 2 tablespoons cheese.
Roll tortillas and place seam side down in tomato sauce.
Repeat; top tortillas with remaining tomato sauce and cheese.
Bake for 30 minutes.
Garnish with green onions and a dollop of sour cream.
Serves 4-6.
notes: Can be prepared ahead and frozen. Defrost before baking. A combination of Cheddar cheese and Monterey Jack cheese can be used. "Serve with a tossed green salad for a great Mexican dinner!"
pdfLink: Beef Enchiladas with Green Chilies and Cheddar Cheese.pdf

title: Beef with Stir-fried Vegetables
ingredients: 1 pound lean beef, cut into thin strips
1 sweet red or green pepper, sliced in strips
directions: Combine marinade; add beef and toss to coat. Marinate for 1 hour.
Combine sugar, soy sauce and cornstarch; set aside to use to thicken sauce.
Prepare all vegetables for cooking.
Heat wok or large frying pan; add oil and garlic. Stir-fry 30 seconds.
Add celery, green pepper and broccoli; stir-fry 2 minutes.
Add cabbage; cook 1 minute.
Add bean sprouts, mushrooms, shallots and green onions; cook 1 minute.
Place vegetables on platter and place in warm oven. Do not wash wok.
Place undrained beef in wok and stir-fry for 2 minutes; add vegetables and chicken broth; bring to boil.
Restir cornstarch mixture and add, as needed, to thicken sauce. Stir constantly.
Do not overcook.
Add sesame oil; mix.
Pour onto serving plate; top with peanuts.
Serve with hot rice.
Serves 4-6.
notes:
Note: Fresh bean sprouts should be rinsed in boiling water before cooking. Be sure to drain well! Pre-sliced stir-fry beef can be found in Ukrop's meat department. Sesame oil is used for flavoring rather than cooking.
"If you like fresh vegetables, you'll love this dish!"
The use of this material and the words 'Words Worth Eating' is licensed by Jacquelyn G. Legg.

title: Crispy Beef Chimichangas with Guacamole and Sour Cream
ingredients: guacamole - mash with lemon juice and salt and pepper
directions: Lay flour tortilla flat - fill with meat
fold and place tooth picks in to hold in place
fry 400 degrees Fahrenheit - 1/2" of grease till brown
3-4 minutes each side
place on bed of lettuce and tomatoes pour sour cream guacamole and sauce (taco) on top garnish and serve
pdfLink: Crispy Beef Chimichangas with Guacamole and Sour Cream.pdf

title: Mexican Ground Beef and Green Chili Meat Mix for Chimichangas
directions: Fry meat
Makes 8 chimichangas
notes: Servings: 8 servings
pdfLink: Mexican Ground Beef and Green Chili Meat Mix for Chimichangas.pdf

title: Meat-za-pie
directions: Place ground beef, evaporated milk, bread crumbs, and garlic salt in two 9-inch pie plates.
Press into the shape of a pie shell.
Spread tomato paste over meat mixture, sprinkle mushrooms over tomato layer.
Top with shredded cheese, sprinkle with oregano then grated cheese.
Bake at 325 degrees for 25 minutes.
notes: The Dawsons

title: Stuffed Paprika Beef Roll with Mushrooms and Olives
directions: Pound until thin, 2 round steaks about 3 pounds.
Rub in salt, pepper, and plenty of paprika.
Overlap steaks on meat board, making 1 large steak.
Spread with a 0.75 pound layer of sliced mushrooms.
Blanket with a layer of thinly sliced onions.
Add pimento.
Cover with finely rolled bread crumbs.
With beater, combine 0.5 cup melted butter, 1 teaspoon boiling water, and 1 raw egg.
Pour over bread crumb mixture.
Arrange stuffed olives in a row on long side of steak.
Begin the roll of meat around olives.
Tie roll firmly.
Flour outside.
Brown in 0.25 cup butter in roaster or deep pan.
Place 6 whole mushrooms and 3 small onions into roaster and sprinkle all lightly with salt, pepper, and paprika.
Add 1 cup red wine.
Bake in 350 degree oven for 2 hours.
notes: Hot or cold. 6 servings.
pdfLink: Stuffed Paprika Beef Roll with Mushrooms and Olives.pdf

title: Sauce Pan Meat Balls
directions: In a deep, thick saucepan, bring to a boil quickly, onion soup mix and water and 1 1/2 cans tomato sauce.
Simmer for 10 minutes (covered).
Mix ground beef, seasonings, parsley, and remaining tomato sauce.
Shape into approximately 16 meat balls and place in sauce.
Simmer gently uncovered - 25 minutes, turning occasionally.
4 servings

title: Barbecued Beef Short Ribs with Onion and Vinegar Sauce
directions: Heat fat in Dutch oven, brown ribs.
Pour off excess fat.
Combine remaining ingredients, pour over meat.
Simmer, covered, turning occasionally, 1 1/2 - 2 hours or until meat is fork tender.
Makes 4 servings.
pdfLink: Barbecued Beef Short Ribs with Onion and Vinegar Sauce.pdf

title: Hearty Hungarian Beef Goulash and Noodles
directions: Brown meat, add onions.
