Add milk, stirring constantly and cook until sauce is smoothed and thickened.
Add shrimp and eggs.
Heat slowly, stirring occasionally until thoroughly heated.
Makes six servings.
notes: Mom Skillet - excellent
pdfLink: Creamy Shrimp and Egg Dish with Chinese Noodles.pdf

title: Shrimp Feta a La Neil
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh or frozen shrimp, thawed, peeled, and deveined

10-inch skillet heat the oil and butter or margarine. Add the garlic and basil. Cook and stir for 30 seconds. Add the mushrooms, onion, and green pepper. Cook over medium-high heat for 4 to 5 minutes more or till vegetables are just tender, stirring occasionally. Add the shrimp and chopped tomato. Cook over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes or till shrimp is just done, stirring occasionally. Combine the water and cornstarch; add to shrimp mixture. Cook and stir till thickened and bubbly. Turn into the pasta crust; spoon tomato sauce atop. Bake in 350° oven for 20 minutes. Sprinkle the mozzarella and feta cheeses atop. Bake 5 minutes more or till cheeses melt. Makes 4 servings.
directions: In a 10-inch skillet heat the oil and butter or margarine.
Add the garlic and basil. Cook and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the mushrooms, onion, and green pepper.
Cook over medium-high heat for 4 to 5 minutes more or till vegetables are just tender, stirring occasionally.
Add the shrimp and chopped tomato.
Cook over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes or till shrimp is just done, stirring occasionally.
Combine the water and cornstarch; add to shrimp mixture.
Cook and stir till thickened and bubbly.
Turn into the pasta crust; spoon tomato sauce atop.
Bake in 350° oven for 20 minutes.
Sprinkle the mozzarella and feta cheeses atop.
Bake 5 minutes more or till cheeses melt.
notes: Makes 4 servings. Photographs: Right, Scott Little; left, Bob Plamondon. BETTER HOMES AND GARDENS, OCTOBER 1984. Page 166.

title: Shrimp Provencale
ingredients: 1 pound large shrimp, peeled and deveined
1 large green pepper, seeded and cut into 1-inch squares
2-3 tomatoes, cut into quarters or eighths
Success Brown Rice, cooked by package directions
directions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.
Place butter or margarine in a 9 x 13 glass baking dish; place in oven only until butter or margarine melts.
Do not brown butter or margarine.
Place shrimp and vegetables in dish; stir to coat with butter or margarine.
Sprinkle with seasonings.
Bake 12-15 minutes or until shrimp are done.
Do not overcook.
Serve over rice.
Serves 4.
notes: Shrimp are done when they become opaque. "Serve with a green salad and hot bread for a delicious and easy seafood dinner!" The use of this material and the words 'Words Worth Eating' is licensed by Jacquelyn G. Legg.

title: Shrimp Curry
ingredients: A few drops of lemon juice
directions: Chop a good size onion very fine and saute in 2 tablespoons butter or margarine with 2 cloves of garlic crushed, and 1/4 teaspoon salt and a little freshly ground pepper.
When onion has browned add 1 can condensed mushroom soup (no water), 2 teaspoons curry powder, 1 package of frozen cooked shrimp.
Heat thoroughly and just before serving add 4 tablespoons sour cream and a few drops of lemon juice.
Serve over rice!
notes: Here's what's cookin' Shrimp Curry Serves 4 Recipe from the kitchen of Bunty Kuykendall

title: Shrimp De Jonghe
ingredients: 4 pounds fresh or frozen shrimp, cooked
directions: Cook shrimp first and clean.
In melted butter, add garlic, parsley, paprika, cayenne, and sherry - mix.
Add bread crumbs; toss.
Place shrimp in greased 11 x 7 x 1 1/2 inch baking dish.
Spoon butter mixture over.
Bake in slow oven 325 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes.
Sprinkle with additional chopped parsley before serving.
notes: 6 to 8 servings

title: Crab Cakes - Donna Dawson
directions: Beat egg whites until stiff.
Add mayonnaise, mustard, and bread to crab meat.
Fold in egg whites.
Add 1 teaspoon Old Bay.
Fry.
notes: Recipe from the kitchen of Donna Dawson. Serves 3.

title: Crab Around the Clock
ingredients: 1 pound Backfin Crabmeat, fresh or pasteurized
1-1 1/2 cups Sour Cream or Mayonnaise (to taste)
directions: Pick over crabmeat to remove any shells.
Gently mix in sour cream (or mayonnaise), cheese, egg, bacon and herbs.
Salt and pepper to taste.
For Breakfast: Great topping for your favorite omelet recipe.
For Entree: Serve over hot rice with fresh asparagus. Top with hot melted cheese sauce or hollandaise sauce. Garnish with parsley.
notes: Serves 4. Adapted from the Virginia Marine Products Board for Ukrop's.

title: Best Ever Baked Crab Cakes
directions: Gently pick through crab to remove all pieces of shell. Do not break apart lumps of crab.
Combine next nine ingredients except for 1/4 cup of mayonnaise; mix well.
Gently fold in crab. DO NOT OVER MIX!
Form into six cakes. Place on a foil-covered cookie sheet.
Spread each crab cake with an equal portion of the reserved mayonnaise, sprinkle with paprika.
Bake in a preheated 350-degree oven for 20 minutes or until golden brown. DO NOT OVERBAKE!
Garnish with parsley and lemon. Serves 4-6.
notes:
Note: Can be prepared early in the day, placed on a cookie sheet, sealed in plastic wrap and baked when ready to serve! This is the perfect way to serve crab cakes to guests. No messy frying at the last minute!
"This easy recipe for golden-brown crab cakes will become one of your favorite crab recipes for family and friends!"
The use of this material and the words 'Words Worth Eating' is licensed by Jacquelyn G. Legg.

title: Hot Oyster Sandwich
ingredients: 1 to 2 cups prepared cocktail sauce (see note)
directions: Bread: Trim a 1-inch slice off top of loaf of bread and set aside. Scoop out inside of loaf leaving a 1-inch shell. (Set bread aside to save for other uses.) Brush inside of bread with melted butter and place on baking sheet. Bake for 6 to 8 minutes in a preheated 400 degree oven; allow to cool completely before filling.

Oysters: Combine eggs and milk in a small bowl and set aside. Combine breadcrumbs and the next 4 ingredients and place in a pie plate or dinner plate. Individually dip oysters in egg mixture and then dredge in breadcrumb mixture; place on a sheet of waxed paper until ready to fry.

To Fry: Pour oil 1-inch deep in a heavy, deep skillet or chicken frying pan. Heat oil to 375 degrees and fry oysters a few at a time for approximately 3 to 4 minutes or until golden brown. Do not overcook. Remove oysters and drain on brown paper. When oysters are fried, use to fill bread and top with the 1-inch top slice. Cut into 2-inch slices and serve immediately with hot sauce, seafood cocktail sauce, sliced lemons and Cole slaw.
Serving suggestion: Use hoagie rolls to make individual sandwiches.
notes: Note: At Ukrop's there are a couple of good cocktail sauces; one from Ukrop's Kitchen and the other is Silver Spring Seafood Cocktail Sauce. "Serve for a football playoff party, on a winter ski trip or for Mardi Gras!" The use of this material and the words 'Words Worth Eating' is licensed by Jacquelyn G. Legg.

title: Fried Oysters with Old Bay Seasoning
directions: Mix the seasoning, bread crumbs and seafood breader in a large bowl.
Strain the oysters and then toss them into the mixture so they get coated.
Lay the oysters out on an ungreased shallow baking pan and freeze them for at least two hours.
To finish, fry the oysters in canola oil at 175 degrees until they're golden and crisp.
Serve with your favorite cocktail sauce.
pdfLink: Fried Oysters with Old Bay Seasoning.pdf

title: Simple Pasta Seafood Salad
ingredients: 1 package Fat Free Louis Kemp™ Crab Delights®
2 cups small fresh broccoli flowerets, steamed if desired
directions: Prepare shells as package directs.
In large bowl, combine all ingredients; mix well.
Cover and chill.
Stir before serving.
Refrigerate leftovers.
notes: TIP: Recipe can be doubled.

title: Summer Fish Steaks on the Grill with Cilantro-lime Butter
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds swordfish or mahi-mahi steaks, approximately 1-inch thick, cut into 4 serving size pieces
directions: Lay the fish steaks side by side in a shallow dish. Combine the oil, juices, salt and pepper and pour over the fish.
Cover and refrigerate 1-2 hours, turning the fish once or twice.
Preheat the broiler or prepare a charcoal fire.
Drain the fish and arrange on the rack in the broiler pan, or set on the grill over the hot coals.
Broil or grill about 5 inches from the heat until just firm to the touch but still moist in the center, 3-4 minutes.
Turn the steaks over once.
When done, transfer to warmed plates and top each fish steak with a pat of the cilantro-lime butter. Serve immediately.
notes: "Sensational!", "The butter is the secret!", from our quick and easy collection, The use of this material and the words 'Words Worth Eating' is licensed by Jacquelyn G. Legg.
pdfLink: Summer Fish Steaks on the Grill with Cilantro-Lime Butter.pdf

title: Grilled Salmon with Fresh Lime Sauce
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets, serving size portions or 1 large salmon fillet, to serve 4
directions: Rub salmon with olive oil and season generously with salt and pepper; grill, starting with flesh side down, for 4-6 minutes on a medium hot gas grill. Turn and continue grilling for 4-7 minutes depending on thickness of fillets. Do not overcook.
SAUCE: Combine all ingredients and chill until ready to serve. Serves 4.
TO SERVE: Place fillets on serving plate and top with sauce and garnish.
notes: GRILLING NOTES: Afraid to grill seafood or a large fillet? The secret to grilling salmon is to oil the fish and the hot grill. Always start with flesh side down and don't move the fillets once they touch the hot grill. Grill on the flesh side only until well marked and lightly cooked; turn with an 1 or 2 extra-wide spatulas and continue grilling skin side down. "Serve with a fresh vegetable salad and grilled garlic bread."
pdfLink: Grilled Salmon with Fresh Lime Sauce.pdf

title: Salmon En Croute with Slivered Almonds and Grated Potatoes
ingredients: Very little thin brown sauce (probably thinned with white wine)
directions: Bake 1 salmon steak (1 to 1 1/2 inches thick).
Separately, dry fry slivered almonds and grated raw potatoes.
Put almonds and potatoes (mixed) on top of salmon for the last 5 to 10 minutes of baking.
Place salmon on top of very little thin brown sauce (probably thinned with white wine).
Serve with lemon half and with a few minced tomatoes sprinkled into it.
notes: 1994 (Princess Anne Country Club)
pdfLink: Salmon En Croute with Slivered Almonds and Grated Potatoes.pdf

title: Joe's Stone Crab Mustard Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons dry mustard, preferably Colman's Dry English Mustard
1 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce, preferably Lea and Perrins
1/2 teaspoon steak sauce, preferably A1 Steak Sauce
directions: Whisk all the dressing ingredients together until the mustard is completely incorporated.

To serve, place a dollop of sauce on top of a cooked fish fillet, or serve it as a dipping sauce with other types of seafood. (The seafood can be either chilled or hot). The sauce can be refrigerated, covered, for up to 2 days.
notes: Makes about 1/2 cup. Start to finish: 5 minutes. Cook's notes: The original Joe's recipe specifies the indicated brand-name products, and we use them to get as close as we can to Joe's famous flavor. However, you may substitute other brands. Nutrients per tablespoon: 106 calories, trace of protein, 0.5 gram carbohydrate, 12 grams fat (97 percent total calories), 8 milligrams cholesterol, no fiber, 92 milligrams sodium.

title: Grilled Alaska Salmon Skewers Amogio
directions: Before grilling, soak 12 wooden skewers in water for at least 30 minutes.
Put salmon on cutting board so that grain of fish is horizontal. Cut salmon lengthwise into 2-inch-wide strips. Place salmon strips in baking dish; set aside.
notes: Makes 6 servings.

title: Fresh Salmon Cakes with Spicy Mayonnaise
ingredients: 3-4 pounds salmon filet uncooked, skinned and cut into small pieces
directions: Put the potatoes in a saucepan of boiling salted water and parboil them for 15 minutes.
Combine salmon, dill, lemon juice, salt and pepper in large bowl.
Drain potatoes and let cool; when cool peel.
Shred potatoes into strips through coarse side of grater box.
Add salmon to the mixture.
Mix gently together; keeping potato strips whole.
Divide the salmon and potato mixture into 8 portions; shaping into patties to approximately 1/2-inch thick.
Pat the patties lightly with flour, shaking off excess.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan.
Add the salmon cakes and fry until crisp and golden brown on both sides, 3-5 minutes.
Drain salmon cakes on paper toweling, place on plate and serve with the spicy mayonnaise.
Serves 4-8 depending on the rest of menu.
notes: "Uses fresh salmon!", ...from our collection of family favorites, "Use as a seafood burger or as the center of a green salad!", The use of this material and the words 'Words Worth Eating' is licensed by Jacquelyn G. Legg.
pdfLink: Fresh Salmon Cakes with Spicy Mayonnaise.pdf

title: Lobster and Artichoke Newburg
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Drain 1 13 ounce can artichoke hearts and cut into bite size pieces.
Melt 3 tablespoons butter, add 1 tablespoon paprika, 1/8 teaspoon pepper, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 cup flour.
Stir ingredients together over medium heat until blended and mixture forms tiny bubbles around edges.
Remove from heat and gradually add 1 cup milk.
Return to low heat and cook until sauce thickens, stirring constantly.
Add 1 cup cottage cheese, 3 hard-cooked eggs, quartered, and artichoke hearts.
Drain 6 1/2 ounce can lobster and cut meat to bite size pieces.
Add to artichoke mixture.
Pour into buttered 1 1/2 quart casserole; arrange strips of pimento on top.
Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes.

title: Grilled Swordfish Steaks with Dijon Mustard
ingredients: 2-3 tablespoons corn oil or extra-virgin olive oil
2-3 teaspoons fresh lemon or lime juice
1-2 tablespoons minced green onions, for garnish
directions: Prepare a charcoal grill for cooking.
Brush cooking area of grill with corn oil.
Combine sauce ingredients and set aside.
Place steaks on grill; brush with sauce.
Grill over a medium-hot to hot fire for 5-7 minutes.
Turn and brush with sauce; cook an additional 5-7 minutes.
Top with lemon and green onions.
Serves 1-4.
notes: Note: Fish is done when fish flakes easily when touched with a fork. This low-cholesterol sauce is good on grilled chicken. "Also delicious with other types of fish steaks and fillets!" The use of this material and the words 'Words Worth Eating' is licensed by Jacquelyn G. Legg.
pdfLink: Grilled Swordfish Steaks with Dijon Mustard.pdf

title: New Orleans Fish Fillets with Almond Butter Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fresh minced parsley, for trim
directions: Soak fillets in milk for 30 minutes; drain and dry well. Season with salt, pepper, and red pepper.
Dust lightly with flour and set aside.
Melt 2 tablespoons butter or margarine in a heavy skillet; add oil. When oil sizzles, sauté fillets 2-3 minutes per side. Cook until golden brown; do not overcook!
Drain fillets and keep warm while preparing sauce.
Drain skillet and add remaining butter or margarine; when melted add almonds and cook over low heat until golden.
Add remaining ingredients except parsley; heat well and pour over fillets.
Garnish with parsley. Serves 4-6.
notes: Any firm white fish fillets can be used in this recipe. \"A sensationally spicy flavor!\" Ukrop's Words Worth Eating. The use of this material and the words 'Words Worth Eating' is licensed by Jacquelyn G. Legg.
pdfLink: New Orleans Fish Fillets with Almond Butter Sauce.pdf

title: Seafood Velvet - Flounder and Shrimp Casserole
ingredients: 1 pound small or medium shrimp, cooked and cleaned
2 tablespoons finely sliced green onions, including tops
1/4 cup plus 2 tablespoons coffee cream or light cream
directions: Break fish into large chunks; remove all bones and skin.
Cut large shrimp in half; set seafood aside.
Combine all remaining ingredients except paprika, sprigs of parsley and lemon; mix well and gently fold in seafood.
Spoon mixture into 6 to 8 lightly greased individual baking shells.
Bake in a preheated 425-degree oven for 15 minutes or until golden. Do not overbake!
Serves 6 to 8.
Garnish with paprika, parsley and lemon slices.
notes: This dish can be prepared early in the day for relaxed entertaining. The flounder should be poached or steamed before adding to this dish. "Serve this elegant flounder dish with a green salad and baked rice!" The use of this material and the words 'Words Worth Eating' is licensed by Jacquelyn G. Legg.
pdfLink: Seafood Velvet - Flounder and Shrimp Casserole.pdf

title: Tuna Oriental
ingredients: 2 cans (6 1/2 or 7 ounces each) tuna in vegetable oil
directions: Drain oil from tuna into skillet. Add celery and green pepper; cook until crisp-tender.
Mix together cornstarch and soy sauce; stir into mixture in skillet.
Drain syrup from pineapple, measure 1 cup. Add to skillet with tomatoes and monosodium glutamate. Bring to boil; boil one minute.
Add tuna and pineapple, heat to serving temperature. Serve over hot cooked rice or noodles.
notes: Yields: 6 servings

title: Seafood Laced with Cheese
ingredients: 1 tablespoon minced celery leaves or celery flakes
1/3 cup chopped green onions, including tops
4 cups grated sharp Cheddar cheese, divided
directions: Gently pick through crab to remove all shell. Do not break apart lumps of crab.
Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat; stir in flour and allow to bubble for 2-3 minutes.
Remove from heat and slowly stir in milk; return to heat and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens to a medium-thick consistency. (Do not overcook.)
Add next 6 ingredients and 3 cups of cheese. Cook over low heat until cheese melts.
Remove from heat and gently fold in seafood mixture into a lightly greased 9 x 13 glass baking dish; top with remaining cheese.
Bake in a preheated 350-degree oven for 30 minutes or until mixture is bubbly and cheese has melted.
Serve over rice. Serves 10-12.
notes: Note: This dish can be prepared 1 day ahead and refrigerated until ready to bake. 'A perfect buffet dish for elegant entertaining!'

title: Baked Fillets Thermidor
ingredients: 1 cup grated sharp Cheddar cheese (1/4 pound)
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Wash fillets, and dry on paper towels.
Melt 2 tablespoons butter. Use to brush dark side of fillets. Sprinkle with salt, pepper, and seasoned salt.
Roll up fillets, seasonings inside. Arrange in a 9-by-9-by-1 3/4-inch baking dish. Pour on 1/2 cup milk; bake, uncovered, 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, in medium saucepan, melt rest of butter. Remove from heat. Add flour, stirring until smooth.
Gradually stir in remaining 3/4 cup milk; bring to boiling, stirring constantly. Reduce heat. Add cheese, stirring until it is melted. Then add the sherry.
Carefully drain liquid from fish; stir into cheese sauce. Pour sauce over fish. Sprinkle with paprika.
Place under broiler, 4 inches from heat, until sauce is golden-brown. Makes 6 servings.

title: Raie Au Beurre Noir (skate Fish with Black Butter)
ingredients: 4 ounces (1 stick) butter cut in pieces
directions: Poach the fish in a mixture of court bouillon and vinegar.
When ready, remove the fish on a towel, skin and place on a serving platter.
Heat an empty skillet until very hot (2 minutes).
Remove from heat and add the butter all at once.
This will smoke.
Return to heat and cook until butter turns dark brown.
Add the juice of one lemon, capers and parsley and pour over the fish.
Quarter the other lemon and decorate
pdfLink: Raie au Beurre Noir (Skate Fish with Black Butter).pdf

title: Fillet of Flounder Ambassador
ingredients: 1 16-ounce package frozen flounder fillets or 4-6 pieces fresh flounder
directions: Thaw fish by package directions, rinse and dry well on toweling.
Preheat oven to 475 degrees Fahrenheit.
Arrange fish in a 9 x 13 glass baking pan and sprinkle with salt, pepper and parsley.
Melt butter in a saucepan; add lemon juice.
Add mushrooms and sauté over low heat.
Stir in flour.
Allow flour to bubble 2-3 minutes.
Add cream and milk and stir until slightly thickened.
Add mustard; mix well.
Pour sauce over fish.
Sprinkle with cheese, breadcrumbs and paprika.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until top is golden brown and fish flakes easily with a fork.
Serves 4.
Serve with rice and a green salad!
notes: The use of this material and the words 'Words Worth Eating' is licensed by Jacquelyn G. Legg.

title: Flounder Divan in Creme Sauce
ingredients: 1 cube Knorr-Swiss Instant Fish Flavor Bouillon and Seasoning or 1 chicken bouillon cube
4 fresh flounder fillets or 1 12-ounce package Gorton's frozen flounder fillets
directions: Prepare sauce by melting margarine in small saucepan, add flour and allow to bubble 2-3 minutes over low heat.
Remove from heat, stir in half and half plus fish seasoning which has been dissolved in 1 cup hot water.
Return to heat; cook until thickened.
Place broccoli in 9-inch pie plate. Microwave on high for 4 minutes; drain well and return to dish.
Top with fillets. Place a pat of butter on each. Cover with vented plastic wrap.
Microwave on high for 3-6 minutes depending on thickness of fillets or until fillets are opaque. (Rotate 1/4 turn every minute.)
Top fillets with mushrooms, creme sauce, cheese and paprika.
Cover and microwave on high for 1-2 minutes or until sauce bubbles.
notes: Frozen fillets do not have to be defrosted. Can also be prepared in individual casseroles. Ready in 15 minutes or less! The use of this material and the words 'Words Worth Eating' is licensed by Jacquelyn G. Legg.

title: Baked Seafood Salad
ingredients: 1 can chunk or solid pack tuna
directions: Mix all gently except chips.
Refrigerate, crush chips and put on top.
Bake 350 degrees for 1/2 hour or until hot through.
notes: Recipe from the kitchen of: Jerri. Can be made a day ahead as marinating improves flavors. Serves 6 - Double for a luncheon for 12 or dinner for 10. (also good served cold, after baking)

title: Nana Willett's Lobster Newburg for 2
directions: Make thin cream sauce.
Put 1/8 pound butter in top of double boiler.
When melted, add 2 tablespoons flour.
When well blended, add about 3/4 quart milk slowly, stirring to avoid lumping.
Add lobster.
Just before serving, add 2 jiggers (about) of sherry, then add one slightly beaten egg yolk.
Add a little of the cream sauce to egg yolk before putting them in sauce.
Serve on toast.
notes: Nana Willett's

title: Baked Seafood Salad
directions: Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.
Serve hot or cold.
notes: Recipe from: Jerri Burd. Serves: 6

title: Salmon Mousse with Shrimp Sauce
ingredients: pieces of onion, carrot, parsley, and bay leaf
a few leaves of dried thyme
salt and white pepper to taste
directions: Put into large saucepan 0.5 cup white wine, 1 cup water and a vegetable bouquet—pieces of onion, carrot, parsley, bay leaf. Add a few leaves of dried thyme, 0.5 teaspoon salt and a few peppercorns.
In this liquid cook a 1.25 pound piece of fresh salmon.
Remove fish from broth; cool. Strain broth into smaller saucepan.
Remove bones and skin from cold salmon. Put into electric mixer with 2 egg whites—unbeaten.
Beat to a smooth fluffy paste.
Whip 1 cup heavy cream until stiff, fold into salmon mixture.
Add salt and white pepper to taste.
Turn into well buttered 1 quart fish mold or a 9 inch ring mold.
Set into baking pan; pour in boiling water to depth of 1 inch; bake at 350 degrees for 45-50 minutes or until it no longer quivers when

title: Salmon Mousse with Shrimp Sauce
directions: Meanwhile, peel and devain a half pound of raw shrimp.
Add to strained fish broth, bring to boil; simmer 5 minutes.
Strain liquid into measuring cup.
There should be 1.5 cups; add water if necessary.
Chop shrimp coarsely.
Put half into a blender with 0.25 cup of the liquid and run until smooth.
In a saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons butter; blend in 3 tablespoons flour.
Add gradually the remaining 1.25 cups of liquid; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens.
Add cut-up shrimp and contents of blender with 1.5 teaspoons finely chopped parsley.
Heat and serve with the mousse.
notes: Con't., 4 servings

title: Salmon Macaroni Bake
ingredients: 2 cans cream of mushroom soup (or celery soup)
directions: Flake salmon coarsely.
Cook macaroni in boiling salted water (H2O) until tender, about 10 minutes.
Drain and combine with rest of ingredients.
Pour into casserole and bake in 375 degree oven about 20 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.
4-6 servings.

title: Flounder Florentine
directions: Fill flounder filets with a mixture of grated parmesan cheese, Monterey Jack, feta, and chopped, cooked frozen spinach.
Season to taste.
Bake.
notes: 1994, Angler's Cave, Va. Beach

title: Tuna Salad Sandwich
ingredients: 2 6-ounce cans Starkist Solid White or Chunk Light Tuna in Spring Water, drained and chunked
2 tablespoons chopped black olives or sweet pickle relish
directions: In medium bowl, combine all ingredients except bread and lettuce; mix well.
Chill several hours.
Line 4 of the bread slices with lettuce; top each with 0.25 cup tuna mixture and top with remaining bread.
notes: Prep Time: 10 minutes. Makes 4 sandwiches. Visit www.starkist.com for more great recipes.

title: Tuna with Tomato Basil Vinaigrette
ingredients: 4 - 8 ounces fresh tuna steaks, cut from center
2 ripe tomatoes, peeled, seeded and coarsely chopped
directions: In bowl, whisk vinaigrette ingredients together - add tomatoes and stir to combine.
Grill tuna that was lightly brushed with olive oil 2 - 3 minutes per side. Tuna should be medium-rare.
Place tomato-basil vinaigrette on top of tuna.
notes: Laura Gough '97

title: Grilled Tuna with Mediterranean Tomato Sauce
directions: Mix all the ingredients.
When ready to serve, warm only.
notes: Julia Dawson 6/2002
pdfLink: Grilled Tuna with Mediterranean Tomato Sauce.pdf

title: Tuna Steak Hawaiian
directions: Preheat grill. Place tuna steaks in a shallow dish; cover with teriyaki sauce, salt and pepper. Allow to marinate 10 to 30 minutes.
After grilling pineapple (see below), grill tuna steaks. Cook only to rare or medium doneness.
Remove from grill and place each steak on prepared pineapple shells; top with grilled pineapple and Pico de Gallo. Serve with pickled ginger. Serves 4.
Topping: Leave green leaves on pineapple; slice pineapple lengthwise in fourths. Remove the whole piece of pineapple from each section; reserve the shell. Remove the core and discard.
Slice the pineapple lengthwise into 2 to 3 pieces. When grill is hot, grill pineapple slices until charred slightly; dice into 1/2 inch cubes and combine with Pico de Gallo.
Set-aside until ready to spoon over tuna.
notes:
...from our quick & easy collection
"Serve with roasted fresh vegetables!"
The use of this material and the words 'Words Worth Eating' is licensed by Jacquelyn G. Legg.

title: Grilled Tuna with Warm Pineapple Salsa
ingredients: 1 16-ounce can pineapple tidbits in its own juice, undrained (PINEAPPLE SALSA)
1-2 jalapeno chile peppers, seeded and chopped (PINEAPPLE SALSA)
directions: Rub both sides of tuna with oil and season with salt and pepper. Grill over medium hot heat for 4-5 minutes per side. Do not overcook. Tuna should have a pink center. Place tuna on serving plates and spoon warm pineapple salsa over one half. Garnish with cilantro and a lime slice.
Serves 4.
Heat all salsa ingredients except cilantro over low heat for 20 minutes. Add cilantro and serve.
Jalapeno note: Wear gloves when handling jalapenos. Canned chiles can be used.
notes: "Easy and spectacular!" ...from our collection of family favorites. "Also delicious with fresh pineapple!" The use of this material and the words 'Words Worth Eating' is licensed by Jacquelyn G. Legg.
pdfLink: Grilled Tuna with Warm Pineapple Salsa.pdf

title: Sweet Pepper Baked Ziti
ingredients: 1 can (28 ounces) whole tomatoes, mashed (reserve 1/4 cup)
directions: Heat oven to 400 degrees - grease 9x13 inch dish.
Cook ziti al dente, adding peppers for last 3 minutes of cooking. Drain.
Combine ziti, peppers, cheeses, tomatoes, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Pour into prepared dish. Pour half-and-half and top with reserved 1/4 cup tomatoes over and cover.
Bake at 400 degrees for 15 minutes. Uncover. Top with bread crumbs. Bake another 15 minutes until crusty and bubbly.
notes: Marked as "Very Good"

title: Wild Rice and Sausage Casserole
ingredients: 1 6-ounce box Uncle Ben's long grain and wild rice mixture with seasonings
directions: Cook and drain sausage; cook rice according to package directions.
Combine all ingredients except cheese and place in a 9 x 13 ungreased baking dish; cover with cheese.
Bake uncovered at 325 for 1 hour.
Serves 8.
notes: Note: Can be prepared a day ahead and baked when ready to serve. Do not omit any of the spices. "Especially delicious for a brunch! Serve with cheese eggs, broiled tomatoes or scalloped apples and a coffee cake!"

title: Night Before Casserole
ingredients: 2 to 3 cups cut up chicken, turkey, ham, or tuna
2 cans cream of mushroom, celery, or chicken soup
directions: Place in greased 9x13 pan and refrigerate overnight.
Remove from refrigerator and bake 1 hour at 350°.
notes: Recipe from: Geri. Serves: 8.

title: Johnny Brochette Casserole
directions: Cook ground beef, onions, celery, green peppers, and mushrooms.
Add sauces and grated cheese (half of it) and olives.
Cook noodles and add.
Bake in large casserole at 350 degrees for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until bubbling.
notes: Recipe from the kitchen of Jean Trachsel. Serves 12.

title: Cheeseburger Pie
ingredients: 2 cups shredded Cheddar cheese, regular or reduced calorie
directions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.
Press rolls into an ungreased 9-inch pie plate to form crust.
Brown beef and drain well.
Add beef and next seven ingredients and simmer 15 minutes.
Remove from heat, stir in egg and pour into crescent roll crust.
Top with cheese.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes or until crust is golden and center is firm.
Serves 4-6.
notes: Note: Can be prepared early in the day and chilled until ready to bake. All you need for a complete dinner is a tossed salad and dessert. "Make several for a crowd!" The use of this material and the words 'Words Worth Eating' is licensed by Jacquelyn G. Legg.

title: Williams-sonoma Chili En Crôute
ingredients: 1/2 cup Urban Accents Rio Grande Chili Powder*
1 can (28 ounce/875g) chopped tomatoes with juices
directions: In a large sauté pan over medium-high heat, combine the ground beef, salt and sugar and cook, stirring, until browned, about 10 minutes. Drain the meat and transfer to a slow cooker.

In the same pan over medium heat, warm the olive oil. Add the flour and cook, stirring, 2 to 3 minutes; do not allow it to brown. Add the onion and sauté for 5 minutes. Add the garlic, chili powder, pepper and oregano and heat, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, 3 to 4 minutes.

Add the tomatoes with their juices and cook for 7 to 10 minutes, then pour the mixture into the slow cooker. Add the stock and cornmeal. Cover and cook for 6 hours on high or 8 hours on low. After the chili is cooked, skim off any fat from the surface.
Preheat an oven to 375°F (190°C).

Prepare the corn bread batter according to the package instructions. Divide the chili evenly among 8 ovenproof bowls. Top each with a scant 1/2 cup (125ml) of the batter. Using a small offset spatula, spread the batter over the center two-thirds of the chili, being careful not to mix the batter with the chili. Place the bowls on a baking sheet and bake until a toothpick inserted into the center of the corn bread comes out clean, 25 to 30 minutes. Serve immediately.
Serves 8.
notes: Williams-Sonoma Kitchen * Available at Williams-Sonoma stores. © Williams-Sonoma, Inc., 2005

title: Wild Rice Party Casserole
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon each celery salt, garlic salt, pepper, onion salt and paprika
directions: Pour boiling water over rice, let stand, covered, 15 minutes and drain.
Place rice in 2 quart casserole.
Add soup, mushrooms with liquid, water and seasonings, mix gently and let stand a few minutes.
Saute onions in oil until glassy. Remove and add to casserole.
Add meat to frying pan and fry, stirring gently until brown and crumbly.
Add to rice and refrigerate.
When ready, bake 2 hours at 325 degrees covered.
notes: Serves: 4, Recipe from the kitchen of: Jerri

title: Neapolitan Beef Casserole
ingredients: 0.75 package "Noodles Italiano"..., Betty Crocker or "Noodle Roni - Parmesan", by Golden Grain
directions: Brown chuck in large frying pan. Add stewed tomatoes, thawed spinach, and cooking sherry. Simmer 10 minutes.
Add seasonings from noodles. Put in casserole and fold in uncooked noodles.
Top with package grated mozzarella cheese. Bake at 375 degrees Fahrenheit for 0.5 hour.
notes: Jane Leffingwell's

title: Chicken and Wine Casserole
directions: Whisk 2 eggs, lemon juice, 1/2 to 3/4 cup dry white wine, and 2 cloves crushed garlic.
Cut chicken into chunks and marinate for a minimum of 2 hours.
Roll in plain breadcrumbs and saute.
Put in casserole with sauted mushrooms and water chestnuts.
Moisten with chicken broth and white wine.
Bake at 350 degrees until bubbly, about 1/2 hour.
Sprinkle Muenster cheese and bake 10 minutes more.
notes: Jackie Pfrang 4/87. Approx measurements for 1 package boneless chicken breasts.

title: Teen Mix (doris's Favorite)
ingredients: 1 large can baked beans (1 pound 12 ounces), undrained
1 large can solid pack tomatoes, undrained
directions: Cut bacon in strips and cook them with the onion in a large heavy kettle like a dutch oven.
Do not brown bacon until crisp - it should be barely cooked.
Add ground beef and brown slightly.
Drain off all excess fat.
Add remaining ingredients and stir gently.
Cover kettle and simmer 1 1/4 hours.
Stir occasionally to prevent sticking.
This may be made ahead and reheated for 4-6 hungry teenagers.
notes: If you prefer less juicy, do not use all liquid with canned tomatoes.

title: Hamburger Stroganoff
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in butter over medium heat. Add meat and brown.
Add flour, salt, pepper, and mushrooms. Cook 5 minutes.
Add soup, simmer uncovered 10 minutes.
Stir in sour cream. Heat through.
Sprinkle with parsley.
Serve with noodles - wide mix.
notes: 4-6 servings

title: Stuffed Manicotti
ingredients: 3/4 pound ricotta cheese (I use large curd cottage cheese)
directions: Brown meat lightly in hot oil and add remaining ingredients. Simmer, uncovered, about 45 minutes.
Combine the following: thyme, marjoram, ricotta cheese, grated Parmesan cheese, beaten egg, and chopped parsley.
Stuff the manicotti with the cheese mixture.
Pour 1/2 the tomato-meat sauce into a 9x13 pan.
Arrange the manicotti in a layer on the sauce.
Top with remaining sauce and sprinkle with Romano cheese.
Cover tightly with aluminum foil and bake 400° oven for 50 minutes.
notes: Jerri

title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef, place in casserole, add remaining ingredients in order given.
Bake 350 degrees for 30 minutes.
notes: Jerre

title: Chop Suey Casserole
directions: Sauté 1 pound ground beef with 2 medium chopped onions.

In a large casserole, mix the following: 2 cups water, 3 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 can cream of chicken soup and 1 can cream of mushroom soup, 3 cups diced celery, 1/2 cup raw rice, and salt and pepper to taste.
Then add meat and onion mixture, mix well.
Cover casserole and bake at 350 degrees for 1 and 1/2 hours.
Uncover and put 1 cup chow mein noodles on top.
Leave cover off and return to oven for another 20 to 30 minutes.
Serves 8
notes: Jerri

title: Zalconi Noodle and Ground Beef Casserole
ingredients: 1 cup water (I use a little more)
directions: Fry onions in butter, add meat, sauce, and water. Then add raw noodles. Cook until tender.
Add remaining ingredients.
Cook 45 minutes in 350° oven.
Let stand in oven 15 minutes before serving.
pdfLink: Zalconi Noodle and Ground Beef Casserole.pdf

title: Hamburger Casserole a La Grecque
directions: Cook meat, onion, garlic, salt, and pepper until beef loses its red color.
Add remaining ingredients and bring to boil.
Put in casserole, cover, and bake at 350 degrees Fahrenheit about 1 1/4 hours.
6 servings.

title: Hamburger Casserole - Jerri Burd
directions: Brown ground beef.
Place in casserole.
Add remaining ingredients in order given.
Bake 350 degrees for 30-40 minutes.
notes: Jerri Burd

title: Fudge Cake with Chocolate Frosting
directions: Mix and pour into a greased and floured 9 by 13 inch pan.
Bake 0.5 hour at 350 degrees.
Melt chocolate, butter, and milk together for frosting.
Add confectioners sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla.
notes: Recipe from the kitchen of Anne Luther 4/12/68

title: Almond Cream Cheese Pound Cake with Lemon Sauce
ingredients: Dash of salt and 1 teaspoon baking powder
2 teaspoons grated lemon rind and 1/3 cup lemon juice (2 lemons)
directions: Cream butter and cream cheese, gradually add sugar, beating at medium speed.
Add eggs one at a time, beating after each addition.
Add flour and salt, stirring until combined.
Stir in almond.
Pour batter into prepared pan.
Bake at 325 degrees for 1 1/2 hours or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.
Cool for 10 minutes in pan, remove and let cool completely.
May serve plain or with lemon sauce.
Lemon Sauce: Cook over medium heat until smooth (first 4 ingredients), then add rest.
notes: From: Cheryl Bergen, Serves: one 10-inch cake
pdfLink: Almond Cream Cheese Pound Cake with Lemon Sauce.pdf

title: Amaretto Cheesecake - Cheryl Burgen
directions: 1 Combine graham cracker crumbs, 2 tablespoons sugar, cinnamon and butter, mix well. Press mixture into springform pan.
2 Beat cream cheese, add sugar, add eggs one at a time. Stir in 1/3 cup amaretto. Pour into prepared pan. Bake at 375 degrees for 45-50 minutes or until set.

3 Combine sour cream, 1 tablespoon + 1 teaspoon sugar and amaretto. Stir well and spoon over the cheesecake. Bake at 500 degrees for 15 minutes. Cool to room temperature, then refrigerate 24-48 hours. Garnish with grated chocolate.
notes: Here's what's cookin': Amaretto Cheesecake. Recipe from: Cheryl Burgen. Serves: 12.

title: Almond Absurdity Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 cup graham or vanilla wafer crumbs
1/4 cup sliced blanched almonds, end-up around edge of cheesecake
directions: Place all crust ingredients in bowl of food processor with steel blade and process till well blended.
Press with fingers into a 10-inch springform pan and refrigerate while making filling.
Place all filling ingredients in bowl of food processor and blend till smooth.
Pour into chilled crust and bake in preheated 325 degree oven for 50 minutes.
Remove from oven and add topping.
Mix all topping ingredients and spread over partially cooked cake.
Return to oven and bake an additional 20 minutes.
Cool and refrigerate.
To garnish, place 1/4 cup sliced blanched almonds, end-up around edge of cheesecake.
notes: Marked with handwritten note 'excellent' and Barbara Slavin quote: 'This is a showy and absolutely delicious dessert... if you like almonds,' claims Slavin. Additional editorial note by Mary Ellen Carter: 'I had considered her inclusion of apple butter in the cheesecake sinful; now with the addition of a shortbread crust and liqueur, I knew we were damned to perdition.' Mary Ellen Carter is food editor of Richmond LifeStyle.

title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake with Lime Glaze
ingredients: 3 tablespoons plus 1/4 cup fresh lime juice
directions: Bake at 325 degrees - grease and flour cake pan.
Sift together flour, baking soda, and salt.
Beat butter and cream cheese until creamy.
Add 3 cups sugar and beat until light and fluffy - add eggs 1 at a time - beat in vanilla and 3 tablespoons lime juice.
Fold in flour, add 1 addition until smooth.
Add lime zest.
Bake 1 hour and 30 minutes - cool 10 minutes.
In small bowl whisk 1/4 cup lime juice, 3/4 cup sugar - brush cake with glaze - cool.
Serves 20
pdfLink: Cream Cheese Pound Cake with Lime Glaze.pdf

title: Turtle Cake
ingredients: 1 box German Chocolate Cake Mix (Fix per directions)
directions: Bake 0.5 of mixture for 10 minutes at 350° in 13x9 pan.
Melt: Chocolate Chips, Carmels, Butter, Evaporated Milk, and Nuts.
Pour over already baked mixture and then pour other 0.5 mixture on top of that and bake for 15-20 minutes.

title: Brown Sugar Pound Cake
directions: Beat butter and shortening together; gradually add the sugars, creaming until light and fluffy.
Beat in eggs, one at a time.
Sift together dry ingredients and add alternately with cream and vanilla.
Stir in nuts.
Pour batter into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan.
Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
Pour walnut glaze over while still hot.
Glaze: Cream 1 cup sifted confectioner's sugar and 2 tablespoons butter.
Add 6 tablespoons cream, 0.5 teaspoon vanilla.
Add 0.5 cup chopped walnuts.
notes: M.I.

title: Brown Sugar Pound Cake (mary Faye Long's)
directions: Cream butter and shortening and add sugar gradually - cream well. Add egg yolks and beat well. Mix and sift the flour, salt, and baking powder - add alternately with milk and vanilla.
Beat egg whites stiff then fold into cake mixture.
Bake in round angle pan lined with paper and greased.
Bake at 325 degrees for 1.5 hours.
pdfLink: Brown Sugar Pound Cake (Mary Faye Long's).pdf

title: Mary Fay's Caramel Frosting
directions: Cook the first mixture of margarine, brown sugar, and evaporated milk for 3 minutes, then thicken with sifted confectioners' sugar.
Alternatively, combine margarine, brown sugar, cream, sifted confectioners' sugar, and vanilla.
notes: Mary Fay's Caramel Frosting (This is good on Brown Sugar Pound Cake). Note: There are two ingredient variations listed on the card.

title: Vanilla, Butter, and Nut Pound Cake
ingredients: 1 small can milk: add water to make 1 cup
directions: Cream shortening, sugar, and salt.
Add eggs one at a time.
Add flour and milk alternately, beginning and ending with flour.
Fold in flavoring by hand.
Bake in greased and floured tube pan (10 inches) 1 hour 45 minutes at 325 degrees.
Start in cold oven.
Do not open door while baking.
Remove from pan immediately.
pdfLink: Vanilla, Butter, and Nut Pound Cake.pdf

title: Pound Loaf Cake
ingredients: 2 teaspoon vanilla or 1 vanilla and 1 lemon
directions: Cream butter, add sugar gradually and cream thoroughly.
Beat egg yolks in well, mix and sift flour and baking powder, add alternately with milk to creamed mixture.
Beat 1/4 cup sugar into beaten egg whites, fold into cake mixture with flavoring.
Bake in a loaf pan at 325 degrees approximately 1-1/2 hours or until it tests done.
Makes one bread pan and one 8"x8" pan.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake with Frosting
ingredients: milk - amount needed for spreading consistency
directions: Cream together butter, fluffo, and sugar.
Sift together flour, baking powder, salt, and cocoa, and add to above.
Add last: eggs (one at a time), sweet milk, and vanilla.
Bake 1.5 hours at 325 degrees in deep tube pan.
notes: (over)

title: Mini Chip Pound Cake
ingredients: Creamy Mini Chip Glaze: Bring 2 tablespoons sugar and 2 tablespoons water to boiling in small saucepan; remove from heat. Immediately add 1/2 cup Mini Chips; stir until melted. Blend in 1 tablespoon marshmallow creme; add hot water, one-half teaspoonful at a time, until desired consistency.
directions: Combine butter, sugar and vanilla in a large mixer bowl; cream until light and fluffy. Add eggs; beat well.
Combine flour, baking powder and salt; add alternately with milk, beating until smooth.
Stir in Mini Chips.
Pour into a greased and floured 12-cup Bundt pan or 10-inch tube pan.
Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour or until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean.
Cool completely; remove from pan. Glaze.

title: Rich Chocolate Chip Bundt Cake
ingredients: 1 cup firmly packed dark brown sugar
directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°. Stir together first 3 ingredients in a small bowl, using a fork. Sprinkle in a greased and floured 12-cup Bundt pan.
2. Whisk together flour, baking soda, and salt.

3. Beat butter, brown sugar, granulated sugar, and vanilla at medium speed with a heavy-duty electric stand mixer 3 to 5 minutes or until fluffy. Add eggs, 1 at a time, beating just until blended. Add flour mixture alternately with buttermilk, beginning and ending with flour mixture. Beat at low speed just until blended after each addition, stopping to scrape bowl as needed. Beat in chocolate mini-morsels. (Mixture will be thick.) Spoon batter into prepared pan.

4. Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes or until a long wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pan on a wire rack 10 minutes; remove from pan to wire rack, and cool completely (about 1 hour). Garnish, if desired.
notes: Makes 12 servings. Hands-on time: 25 minutes. Total time: 2 hours, 25 minutes. This is my sister Jennifer's favorite birthday cake. She has been known to ask for two on her special day (one for her and one for everyone else). Marked as "Very Good" (VG).

title: Choc Chip Bundt Cake
directions: Cream together cream cheese, butter, and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Then sift dry ingredients together, add alternately with milk.
Add vanilla and fold in chips.
Bake in greased and floured bundt pan.
Bake 350 degrees for 50 minutes.
notes: A favorite recipe from Nancy Dawson. Anne Luther.

title: Fresh Lemon Pound Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees; grease a 10-inch bundt cake or tube pan.
Mix lemon gelatin in water in mixing bowl; stir until completely dissolved.
Add oil and cake mix; mix on low speed until cake is completely mixed in.
Increase speed to medium and add eggs, one at a time.
Stir in lemon juice and extract.
Pour into prepared pan and bake for 1 hour or until cake springs back when pressed gently.
Remove from oven and place on cooling rack for 10 minutes; remove from pan and slowly pour juice of 2 fresh lemons over hot cake.
Allow cake to stand several hours before serving.
When ready to serve, sift powdered sugar over top of cake.
Yields 12-16 servings.
notes: Starts with a mix! A great traveling cake that goes well with all summer picnic foods. Good with fresh berries. The use of this material and the words 'Words Worth Eating' is licensed by Jacquelyn G. Legg.

title: White Chocolate Cheesecake
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely chopped almonds or macadamia nuts, toasted
directions: To make crust, combine flour and sugar. Cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in remaining ingredients; mix well. Press onto bottom and sides of 9-inch springform pan. Chill.
For filling, combine chocolate and cream in double boiler; cook, stirring constantly over simmering water, until chocolate is melted. Stir in vanilla; keep warm.

In a separate bowl combine cream cheese and milk, mixing at medium speed on electric mixer until well blended. Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each addition. Stir in chocolate mixture, mixing well. Pour over crust. Bake at 325 degrees for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Loosen cake from rim of pan. Cool before removing rim of pan. Chill. Garnish with strawberries and powdered sugar if desired.
Makes 12-14 servings.
notes: Williamsburg resident Gloria Pleasants won the cheesecake category in the 1988 'Philly' Hall of Fame Recipe Contest sponsored by Kraft, Inc. Ms. Pleasants, one of 6,000 entrants, won a trip for two to New Orleans for her white chocolate cheesecake recipe. Here's her recipe.

title: Diane's Individual Cheesecakes
directions: Mix cream cheese, lemon juice, vanilla, eggs, sugar and salt with electric mixer until smooth.
Line muffin tins with baking cups. Place 1 vanilla wafer in bottom of each cup.
Fill 3/4 full with cheese mixture.
Bake 20 minutes in 350 degree oven. Cool one hour and refrigerate or freeze for later use.
Before serving, top each with a spoonful of cherry pie filling and remove from papers. Makes 18.
(For smaller cheesecakes, use graham cracker crust mixture in bottom of miniature paper baking cups in tiny tins. Use one cherry atop each cake.)
notes: Recipe from: Mrs. John Dalton

title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake with Cinnamon and Pecans
directions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.
Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time; beat well.
Sift dry ingredients and mix alternately with sour cream.
Start and end with flour; add vanilla.
Pour batter into a greased and floured 9x13 pyrex dish.
Prepare topping of brown sugar, sugar, spices and half of pecans.
Spread 3/4 of the topping mixture over the batter; use a knife to swirl topping into top of batter.
Sprinkle remaining topping over batter and top with remaining pecans.
Bake 30 minutes.
Yields 20-24 squares.
Serve warm with soft butter.
notes: Words Worth Eating - Cub Foods Super Markets
pdfLink: Sour Cream Coffee Cake with Cinnamon and Pecans.pdf

title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar, add eggs and sour cream. Mix sifted dry ingredients and add to butter mix. Add vanilla.
Pour 1/2 batter in pan. Sprinkle 1/2 topping over.
Pour remainder batter, rest of topping.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Put cake in, immediately reduce to 300 degrees. Bake 1 hour.
Grease pan with butter. 10 x 14 pan.
notes: Marked as "Very Good" (excellent), 11/62, with Greek

title: Happy Day Cake
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups sifted Swans Down Cake Flour
directions: Sift flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar.
Stir shortening just to soften.
Add dry ingredients, 3/4 cup of the milk, and the vanilla.
Mix until all flour is dampened.
Then beat 2 minutes at medium speed of electric mixer or 300 vigorous strokes by hand.
Add eggs and remaining 1/4 cup milk.
Beat 1 minute longer with mixer or 150 strokes by hand.
BAKING: Pour batter into two 9-inch layer pans which have been lined on bottoms with paper.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes, or until cake tester inserted into center comes out clean.
This cake may also be baked in three 8-inch layer pans at 350° about 25 to 30 minutes, or in a 13 x 9-inch pan about 30 to 35 minutes.
Cool; then frost as desired.

title: Lighter Dump Cake
ingredients: 1 20-ounce can crushed pineapple in natural juice, undrained
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Lightly spray a 9-by-13-by-2 inch pan with nonstick vegetable coating.
Dump undrained pineapple into prepared pan and spread evenly across bottom.
Dump in cherry pie filling; spread evenly.
In a bowl, stir together cake mix, oil and water just enough to blend; do not overbeat.
Pour batter evenly over pie filling.
Sprinkle with pecans.
Bake until cake is crusty and golden, about 40 minutes.
notes: Makes 12 servings. Nutrients per serving: 277 calories, 11 grams fat (35.7 percent total calories), 0.9 milligrams cholesterol, 191 milligrams sodium.

title: Dump Cake
directions: Layer ingredients - Do not mix in 13x9 inch pan.
Bake 350 degrees - 1 hour.
notes: Recipe from the kitchen of: Donna Dawson. Serves:

title: Hummingbird Cake
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large mixing bowl; add eggs and oil, stirring until dry ingredients are moistened. Do not beat. Stir in vanilla, pineapple, 1 cup pecans, and bananas.

Spoon batter into 3 greased and floured 9-inch round cakepans. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pans 10 minutes; remove from pans, and cool completely.
Spread frosting between layers and on top and sides of cake; then sprinkle 1/2 cup chopped pecans on top. Yield: one 3-layer cake.
Combine cream cheese and butter, beating until smooth. Add powdered sugar and vanilla; beat until light and fluffy. Yield: enough frosting for one 3-layer cake.
notes: Mrs. L. H. Wiggins, Greensboro, North Carolina. The name of this recipe describes this cake to a tee. Submitted by Dondee Gage Steves of San Antonio for our September 1977 issue, it's kept a steady stream of letters coming ever since. One reader even declares she's given away as many copies of the recipe as we have.

title: Hot Milk Cake
directions: Beat eggs until light and fluffy.
Add sugar and beat until creamy.
Add sifted flour, baking powder, vanilla, and lemon extract.
Put butter into milk. Heat milk and butter until butter melts (do not boil).
Then add to the eggs, sugar, and flour mixture.
Pour into tube pan and bake at 325 degrees for 1 and 1/4 hours.
notes: This is like a pound cake

title: Lemon Meringue Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar, add egg and yolks, mix well.
Combine flour and baking powder, add to creamed mixture alternately with milk, mix well.
Add vanilla.
Pour into greased and floured 9 inch round cake pan.
Bake at 350 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes or until wooden pick comes out clean.
Cool in pan 10 minutes, remove to wire rack and cool completely.
Filling: In a heavy saucepan, combine egg yolks, water, sugar, flour, and peel.
Bring to gentle boil over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Cook and stir for 2 to 3 minutes or until thickened.
Stir in lemon juice and butter.
Place cake on a baking sheet, spoon filling on top of cake up to 0.5 inch from edge.
Meringue: Beat egg whites until foamy, add cream of tartar, beat on high for 1 minute.
Add sugar 1 tablespoon at a time, beating well after each addition.
Beat until stiff peaks form (about 3 minutes).
Carefully spread over filling, sealing to edges of cake.
Bake at 350 degrees for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned.
Yields 6 to 8 servings
notes: Sally Ditruck May '98

title: Shirley Adams' German Chocolate Angel Cake
directions: Melt in double boiler and cook for 5 minutes: 3 tablespoons butter, 3 tablespoons sugar, 3 egg yolks, and 1 bar chocolate.
Beat 3 egg whites and fold into chocolate mixture.
Spoon into pan (buttered), add angel food cake in chunks, alternating layers.
Refrigerate for 3 or 4 hours.
Serve with whipped cream over.
notes: Shirley Adams - Rich but good.
pdfLink: Shirley Adams' German Chocolate Angel Cake.pdf

title: Bacardi Rum Cake with Coconut and Pineapple Frosting
ingredients: 1 package (4-serving size) Jell-O Coconut Cream Flavor or Vanilla Instant Pudding and Pie Filling*
1 package (4-serving size) Jell-O Coconut Cream Flavor or Vanilla Instant Pudding and Pie Filling
directions: Blend all ingredients except coconut in large mixer bowl.
Beat 4 minutes at medium speed of electric mixer.
Pour into 2 greased and floured 9-inch layer pans.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly pressed. Do not underbake.
Cool in pan 15 minutes; remove and cool on racks.
Fill and frost; sprinkle with coconut.
Chill. Refrigerate leftover cake.
For frosting, combine all ingredients except whipped topping in a bowl; beat until well blended.
Fold in thawed whipped topping.
notes: *With vanilla flavor filling, increase water to 3/4 cup; add 1 cup flaked coconut to batter. title: Yum Yum Cake
directions: Stir together and spoon include juice - slice mandarin oranges in thirds.
Pour equally in three 8-inch cake pans.
Bake at 325 degrees for 20 minutes.
Mix pudding and cool whip.
Add crushed pineapple.
notes: Debbie Hamps

title: Orange Date Nut Cake - Mom Hodge
directions: Combine dates and nuts and 1 cup of the flour. Mix together and set aside.
Cream butter well, add sugar, cream until light and fluffy.
Add one egg at a time. Beat well.
Sift all dry ingredients together.
Add dry ingredients and butter mixture. Blend well.
Fold floured dates and nuts and orange rind.
Pour into well greased and floured tube pan.
Bake at 300 degrees for 1 1/2 hours.
For the glaze: Mix orange juice and sugar in a sauce pan. Bring to boil only.
Pour mixture over hot cake from oven. Set to cool.
notes: Excellent
pdfLink: Orange Date Nut Cake - Mom Hodge.pdf

title: Buttermilk Cake with Brown Sugar Nut Topping
ingredients: Topping: Melt 3 tablespoons butter, mix with 0.5 cup brown sugar, 1 cup nuts (cut fine), and 3 tablespoons cream.
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Add egg yolks.
Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk.
Add vanilla.
Fold in egg whites.
Bake in 9 x 13 pan for 50 minutes at 350 degrees.
Spread topping evenly on top.
Broil 1 to 2 minutes.
notes: Jerri
pdfLink: Buttermilk Cake with Brown Sugar Nut Topping.pdf

title: Blueberry Upside-down Cake
directions: Grease and flour pan.
Sift flour and measure. Sift again with next three ingredients.
Cream shortening and sugar and cinnamon until smooth.
Add eggs and beat until light in color.
Add milk alternately with dry ingredients.
Gently fold in blueberries.
Bake at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 45 minutes.
Serve with Lemon Sauce.

title: Orange and Raisin Cake
ingredients: For Glaze: 1 cup of extra sugar, juice of 1 orange, let stand
Optional Orange Sauce: 1 cup sugar, 1 egg --- mix thoroughly
Optional Orange Sauce: 1/2 cup butter (1 stick)
Optional Orange Sauce: Juice and grated rind from 1 large orange
directions: Grind orange rind and raisins 3 times - mix well.
Cream shortening and sugar, add 2 eggs unbeaten, mix well together.
Add sour milk, mix, add orange rind-raisins mixture.
Add flour, salt and soda sifted together (in about 3 parts).
Bake in square pan (9 or 10 inches) greased and floured, 40 minutes at 375 degrees.
When baked stir sugar and orange juice well, pour over cake as soon as removed from oven.
For Optional Orange Sauce: Put all together and cook few minutes. Top with whipped cream.
notes: The cake is best when it stands about 24 hours before serving. (Orange Sauce, you may like)

title: Jim Stauts' Apricot Lime Cake
directions: Mix together, add 4 eggs (one at a time), beat one minute after each.
Bake in angel food cake pan (butter sides and bottom) at 350 degrees for 55 minutes.
Glaze while hot: 1 cup buttered sugar and 3 to 4 tablespoons nectar.
notes: Jerri

title: Cupcakes with Orange Frosting
directions: Mix according to the usual method for butter cakes, and bake in gem tins.
Let the rind stand in the orange juice for 15 or 20 minutes.
Strain and add the yolk of the egg to the juice, mix thoroughly and add confectioners' sugar until of the right consistency to spread.
notes: Good for lunches

title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: Cream shortening and add coloring and sugar.
Sift flour and cocoa and salt together.
Add to creamy mixture then add milk; then add one egg at a time, beat vigorously, add vinegar and soda (I put the soda in the buttermilk), beat again.
Bake 350 degrees in 2 deep layers or 3 medium layers.
Icing for Cake: 5 tablespoons flour, 1 cup milk, mix together and cook until thick. Cool.
1 cup sugar, 1 cup margarine, beat until fluffy then add to flour mixture. 1 tablespoon vanilla.

title: Peach Lemon Angel Cake
ingredients: 1 package lemon chip angel food mix
1 pound fresh peaches, sliced and sweetened
directions: Prepare cake mix according to package directions, baking in tube pan.
Cool upside down in pan as directed.
Then cut horizontally into 3 even layers.
Whip cream until soft peaks form.
Spread part of cream on one layer, cover with sliced peaches.
Repeat stacking cake and ending with whipped cream and peaches on top.

title: Milky Way Cake
directions: Melt 6 Milky Way candy bars and 1/2 stick margarine together, then let cool.
Mix well 1 cup buttermilk and 1/2 teaspoon soda, and add to the melted Milky Ways and margarine.
Cream 1 1/2 sticks of margarine and 2 cups sugar. Add 4 eggs, one at a time.
Combine 2 1/2 cups of sifted plain flour and 1/2 cup of nuts, and add to the first mixture.
Bake at 300 degrees for 1 hour, or divide into 3 layers and bake about 35 minutes.
To prepare the frosting: combine 4 Milky Way candy bars, 1 stick margarine, and 3 tablespoons sweet milk. Heat over hot water until melted.
Remove from heat and add 1 teaspoon vanilla.
Add 1/2 box sifted powdered sugar. If frosting is too thick, add more milk.

title: Chocolate Macaroon Cake
ingredients: 2 cups (7-ounce package) fine-grated coconut (or fresh coconut grated)
1 tablespoon Pillsbury's Best All Purpose Flour
2 cups sifted Pillsbury's Best All Purpose Flour
directions: Beat 1 egg white with 1 teaspoon vanilla until soft mounds form.
Add 1/2 cup sugar gradually beating until stiff peaks form.
Stir in coconut and 1 tablespoon flour.
Dissolve cocoa in hot coffee.
Beat 3 egg whites until soft mounds form.
Add 1/2 cup sugar gradually, beating until meringue stands in stiff peaks.
Add soda to sour cream.
Beat 1 and 1/4 cups sugar, shortening, egg yolks, 1/2 teaspoon salt, 1 teaspoon vanilla and half of cocoa mixture until light and creamy, about 4 minutes.
Add 2 cups flour, the sour cream and remaining cocoa mixture; blend well.
Fold in egg whites.
Turn 1/3 of chocolate batter into 10-inch tube pan, greased on bottom.
Place 1/2 coconut mixture on top.
Cover with 1/2 of remaining chocolate batter.
Top with remaining coconut, then chocolate batter.
Bake at 350 degrees for 55 or 65 minutes.
Cool completely before removing from pan.
Frost top and sides.
Makes 10-inch tube cake.
notes: So good, we think!

title: Rum Torte by Ann King
ingredients: 1 large package Chip-A-Roo chocolate chip cookies
directions: Mix 1 cup orange juice and 1/4 cup rum; run cookies through mixture.
Layer cookies, and spread with Cool Whip; 3 layers or 4, ending with Cool Whip.
Refrigerate, turn out, and ice with Cool Whip.
notes: 1988, Ann King, use springform pan, very good!!

title: Rum Cake
directions: Beat eggs in one at a time.
Mix in order and pour into greased and floured tube pan.
Bake at 325 degrees Fahrenheit for 50-60 minutes.
While still hot, pour sauce over cake.
Boil sauce ingredients together until bubbly (5 minutes).
Prick holes in top of cake, pour sauce over, let soak, then turn out on server.
Confectioners' sugar on top for decoration.
notes: 1975, Pris Morgan

title: Whipped Cream Devil's Food Cake with Whipped Cream Chocolate Frosting
directions: Start your oven at 375 degrees Fahrenheit or moderate.
Grease bottoms and sides of cake pans and dust with flour.
Sift cake flour, measure it carefully and sift again with soda and salt.
Cream or work butter in bowl.
Then add sugar a little at a time and continue creaming until fluffy and light.
Add unbeaten eggs, one at a time.
Melt chocolate over boiling water.
Add to batter.
Sift 1/3 of the flour into batter, stir well, add 1/3 of milk and stir slightly. Repeat.
Now mix in vanilla and boiling water.
Batter will be thin.
Bake at 25 to 30 minutes.
For the Whipped Cream Chocolate Frosting: Mix (do not whip) all ingredients in a bowl.
Set in refrigerator to chill for 2 hours or longer.
Then beat mixture until so thick it holds its shape and will stand in peaks.
notes: Marked as "Good"
pdfLink: Whipped Cream Devil's Food Cake with Whipped Cream Chocolate Frosting.pdf

title: Lemon Rum Cake - Jerri
directions: Mix well.
Pour into a springform or angel food cake pan.
Bake 45 minutes at 350°.
Glaze while hot:
notes: Glaze ingredients: 1 cup powdered sugar, 1/4 cup lemon juice, 3 tablespoons rum.

title: Lemon Cake with Glaze
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines Lemon Supreme Cake
directions: Mix and beat 4 minutes and bake in 350 degrees for 40 to 50 minutes.
Bake in greased angel food cake pan.
Poke holes with fork about every inch or so and pour glaze over warm cake.

title: Harvey Wallbanger Cake
directions: In large mixer bowl, combine cake mix and pudding mix.
Add the eggs, oil, the 1/2 cup orange juice, the 1/2 cup Galliano, and the 2 tablespoons vodka.
Beat on low speed of electric mixer for 1/2 minute; beat on medium speed for 5 minutes, scraping bowl frequently.
Pour into greased and floured 10-inch fluted tube pan; bake in 350° oven for 45 minutes.
Or, pour into two greased 9-inch round cake pans; bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.
Cool in pan 10 minutes; remove to rack and pour on glaze while cake is still warm.
To make glaze: combine the powdered sugar, the 1 tablespoon orange juice, the 1 tablespoon Galliano, and the vodka.

title: German Chocolate Refrigerator Cake
ingredients: 1 large package (5 ounces) Jell-O Vanilla Pudding and Pie Filling
1 bar (4 ounces) Baker's German's Sweet Chocolate, broken in squares
directions: Blend pudding mix, instant coffee and gelatin in saucepan.
Stir in milk.
Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture boils.
Remove from heat.
Stir in chocolate.
Cool, stir often.
Whip cream, fold 1 1/2 cups into pudding.
Pour 1/2 cup pudding into 1 1/2 quart mold or mixing bowl.
Line sides with ladyfingers.
Pour in pudding.
Top with ladyfingers.
Chill 3 hours.
Dip in warm water, loosen, unmold.
Top with whipped cream.
Serves 6 to 8.
notes: Baker's, German's, Jell-O and Maxwell House are trade-marks of General Foods Corp.

title: Mince Pecan Cake
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups prepared mincemeat (I used the small package mincemeat but first prepared it as for directions on package (like you were going to make a pie))
directions: All ingredients must be at room temperature.
Sift together 2 1/2 cups sifted enriched flour, 2 teaspoons double-action baking powder, and 1 teaspoon salt.
Cream 1/2 cup shortening (1 stick); add gradually 1 1/2 cups sugar, creaming well.
Blend in 3 eggs, one at a time. Beat for 1 minute.

Combine 1 cup milk and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Add alternately with dry ingredients to creamed mixture, beginning and ending with dry ingredients. Blend thoroughly after each addition (with electric mixer use low speed).
Blend in 1/2 cup chopped pecans and 1 1/2 cups prepared mincemeat.
Pour into three well-greased and floured 9-inch round layer cake pans.
Bake in moderate oven (350 degrees) 30 to 35 minutes.
Cool and frost. I used caramel frosting.
If desired, cake may be baked in 15 x 10 x 2-inch pan for 40 to 45 minutes. Or ingredients may be cut in half and cake baked in 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan for 40 to 45 minutes.
notes: I used caramel frosting.

title: Cherry Upside-down Cake
ingredients: No. 2 can (2 1/2 cups) tart red pitted cherries
A few drops red food coloring
directions: Drain and reserve juice from No. 2 can (2 1/2 cups) tart red pitted cherries.
Place cherries, 1/2 cup sugar, 1 tablespoon butter, and a few drops red food coloring in a saucepan.
Heat thoroughly; pour into an 8-inch round cake pan.
Stir 1/4 cup shortening to soften.
Sift in the dry ingredients: 1 cup sifted flour, 3/4 cup sugar, 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder, and 1/2 teaspoon salt.
Measure 1/2 cup milk, add all except 2 tablespoons. Mix until flour is dampened.
Beat 2 minutes with mixer at slow speed.
Add remaining milk and 1 egg.
Beat 1 minute.
Pour batter over cherries.
Bake 350 degrees for 45-50 minutes.
Remove from oven, let stand 10 minutes, loosen, and invert onto a plate.
notes: Good (circled), Mom Gillette's

title: Cherry Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Cook, stirring until thick.

title: Hungarian Chocolate Cake
directions: Beat sugar into whites, a tablespoon at a time.
Add cocoa.
Fold in yolks.
Spread in buttered and floured cookie sheet with sides 10 x 14 inches.
Bake at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 20 minutes.
Turn out on floured cloth. Cover with damp cloth. Cool.
Cut into 4 squares and spread with whipped cream (between layers only).
Melt 2 squares chocolate and add 0.5 cup confectioners' sugar and 1 tablespoon hot water. Blend well.
Add 1 egg, beat until smooth, add 3 tablespoons butter, and spread entire cake.
notes: Dinge

title: Ferri's Chocolate Cake
directions: Put in mixing bowl and beat together: 2 cups sugar, 2 eggs, and 1/2 cup salad oil. Mix until creamy.
Add and mix for 5 minutes: 2 cups flour, 2 teaspoons baking powder, 2 teaspoons baking soda, 1 teaspoon salt, 3/4 cup cocoa, 1 cup milk, 1 cup cooked black coffee (cooled), and 1 teaspoon vanilla.
Pour into a 9x13 greased and floured pan.
Bake for 35 minutes at 350 degrees.
notes: Ferri

title: Festive Cake - Lydia Hunt
directions: Mix together flour, sugar, baking soda, salt, and cinnamon. Stir in almonds.
Beat eggs slightly, combine with oil, almond extract, bananas, and undrained pineapple.
Add to dry ingredients, mix thoroughly, but do not beat.
Spoon into well-oiled 10-inch tube pan (I use pan).
Bake at 325 degrees Fahrenheit for 1 hour and 20 minutes.
Remove from oven, let stand 10 minutes, invert on rack and cool.
May use a cream cheese frosting.
notes: Lydia Hunt, 1976

title: Bacardi Dark Rum Chocolate Pudding Cake
ingredients: 1 package (4-serving size) Jell-O Chocolate Instant Pudding and Pie Filling
1 package (4-serving size) Jell-O Chocolate Instant Pudding and Pie Filling
1 envelope Dream Whip Whipped Topping Mix
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit. Grease and flour two 9-inch layer cake pans.
Combine all cake ingredients together in large bowl. Blend well, then beat at medium mixer speed 2 minutes.
Turn into prepared pans. Bake 30 minutes or until cake tests done. Do not underbake.
Cool in pans 10 minutes. Remove from pans, finish cooling on racks.
Split layers in half horizontally. Stack.
Spread 1 cup filling between each layer and over top of cake.
Keep cake chilled. Serve cold.
Optional: garnish with chocolate curls.
For filling, combine milk, rum, pudding mix and topping mix in deep narrow-bottom bowl. Blend well at high speed for 4 minutes, until light and fluffy. Makes 4 cups.
notes: BACARDI rum. The mixable one. Made in Puerto Rico. For a free deluxe booklet of recipes for desserts, entrees, hors d'oeuvres, snacks, drinks and punches, write to: Bacardi Imports, Inc., Bacardi Bldg., Dept. CCC, Miami, FL 33137. Rum 80 proof. Bacardi and the bat device are registered trademarks of Bacardi & Company Limited. Wesson is a registered trademark of Hunt-Wesson Foods, Inc. Jell-O and Dream Whip are registered trademarks of General Foods Corporation.
pdfLink: Bacardi Dark Rum Chocolate Pudding Cake.pdf

title: Bacardi Rum Cake
ingredients: 1 3 3/4-ounce package JELL-O instant vanilla pudding mix
directions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees Fahrenheit. Grease and flour 10-inch tube or 12-cup Bundt pan.
Sprinkle nuts over bottom of pan. Mix all cake ingredients together. Pour batter over nuts.
Bake 1 hour. Cool.
Invert on serving plate. Prick top. Drizzle and smooth glaze evenly over top and sides. Allow cake to absorb glaze. Repeat till glaze is used up.
For glaze, melt butter in saucepan. Stir in water and sugar. Boil 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in rum.
Optional: Decorate with whole maraschino cherries and border of sugar frosting or whipped cream. Serve with seedless green grapes dusted with powdered sugar.
notes: For a deluxe booklet of recipes for drinks, punches, snacks, hors d'oeuvres and entrées, write to: Bacardi Imports, Inc., Bacardi Bldg., Miami, FL. 33137. Rum 80 proof. Booklet offer void where prohibited by law.

title: Pig-picking Supreme Cake
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines Butter Cake (Do not add butter)
1 (11 ounce) can mandarin oranges and juice
1 medium can crushed pineapple and juice
directions: Blend all ingredients together and bake, three 9 inch cake pans at 350 degrees for 15-20 minutes, or until done.
Using mixer, blend all filling ingredients together. Spread on cake.
Keep refrigerated.

title: Apricot Delight
directions: Cook the above until thick.
Cool slightly.
Break up an angel food cake.
Put in 13 x 9 pan.
Pour apricot mixture over top.
Cover with 1 1/2 pints whipped cream.
Chill overnight.
notes: Recipe from the kitchen of St. Louis's

title: Refrigerator Cake by Nancy Beukle
ingredients: 1 box cake mix - Butter mix (Duncan Hines)
directions: Make cake according to package in 9x13 pan.
Punch holes in cake with straw while it is still hot.
Pour over cake while still hot: 1 can Eagle Brand milk and 1 can chocolate syrup.
Cool, then spread 12 ounces container of Cool Whip on top.
Sprinkle with chocolate shavings.
Refrigerate overnight.
Alternative: Use 1 can (medium) cream of coconut mix instead of chocolate syrup, and sprinkle cake with 1 (6 ounce) package frozen coconut.
notes: Nancy Beukle

title: Grandma Gough's 1-2-3-4 Orange Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar, then add eggs one at a time.
Mix dry ingredients.
Add dry ingredients to mixture of butter, sugar, and eggs.
Grate lemon and orange, then extract juice and rind.
Add 4 tablespoons juice mixture to cake.
Save rest for frosting.
Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes in 9-inch cake pans.
For the frosting: cream powdered sugar, 1 stick butter, salt, and the juice mixture from orange and lemon together.
notes: Recipe from the kitchen of Laura Hodge, Grandma Gough's 1-2-3-4 orange cake

title: Orange Sponge Cake - Jerri
directions: Beat egg yolks lightly, add sifted sugar - beat well.
Add orange juice and flour.
Add well beaten egg whites.
Bake in medium hot oven in large cake pan (angel food preferred) for about 30 minutes.
Serve with crushed pineapple and whipped cream.
notes: Jerri

title: Orange Cake with Dates and Pecans
directions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and orange rind.
Sift dry ingredients together and add alternately with milk.
Flour dates and nuts. Fold into batter.
Bake 1 hour at 275 degrees.
When done, pour mixture of 1/2 cup orange juice and 1/2 cup sugar over cake while hot. (Mix this at the beginning so sugar will be thoroughly dissolved.)
Let stand overnight in refrig.
Bake in loaf pan or tube pan.
notes: Marked as "good"
pdfLink: Orange Cake with Dates and Pecans.pdf

title: Nat's Chocolate Cake
directions: Cream one stick butter and 1 cup sugar.
Add 4 eggs, one at a time.
Add 1 cup flour, 1 teaspoon baking powder, pinch salt, 1 can Hershey's chocolate syrup, 1 teaspoon vanilla.
Pour into 9x13 pan (greased and floured) and bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.
Start frosting about 20 minutes after cake is in the oven.
For frosting: boil one minute, take off stove and add 1/2 cup chocolate bits.
Stir until melted.
Will be runny.
Pour over cake and let cool.
notes: 350 degrees, 30 minutes

title: Easy Bunny Cake
ingredients: Two 9 inch round cake layers cooled
directions: Cut one layer as shown; leave other whole. Tint 1/4 cup coconut pink by tossing with red food coloring.
Arrange cake, using frosting to hold pieces together.
Frost entire cake. Sprinkle with coconut and decorate with candies.

title: Fudge Ribbon Cake with Chocolate Frosting
directions: Cream 2 tablespoons butter and cream cheese and 1/4 cup sugar and 1 tablespoon cornstarch. Beat till creamy and set aside.
Combine flour, 2 cups sugar, salt, baking soda and powder in bowl.
Add 1/2 cup butter and 1 cup milk. Blend, then beat 1 1/2 minutes.
Add 1/3 cup milk, 2 eggs, choco bake and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Beat.
Put 1/2 batter in 9x13 pan and spoon on cream cheese mixture.
Spread on remaining batter.
Bake 350 degrees for 45 minutes.
Combine milk and butter in pan. Bring to a boil.
Remove from heat. Blend in chocolate morsels. Stir in vanilla and sugar.
Beat till creamy.
notes: Includes recipe for Frosting for Fudge Ribbon Cake. 9x13 pan at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.
pdfLink: Fudge Ribbon Cake with Chocolate Frosting.pdf

title: Chocaholic Cake by Geri
ingredients: 1 package yellow cake mix (Betty Crocker Super Moist)
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients until smooth.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Pour into a greased and floured bundt cake pan and bake for 1 hour at 325 degrees.
notes: Recipe from: Geri

title: German Sweet Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 1 package (4 ounces) Baker's German's Sweet Chocolate
1 cup (2 sticks) margarine or butter, softened
directions: HEAT oven to 350°F. Line bottoms of 3 (9-inch) round cake pans with wax paper.

MICROWAVE chocolate and water in large microwavable bowl on HIGH 1 1/2 to 2 minutes or until chocolate is almost melted, stirring halfway through heating time. Stir until chocolate is completely melted.*

MIX flour, baking soda and salt; set aside. Beat margarine and sugar in large bowl with electric mixer on medium speed until light and fluffy. Add egg yolks, 1 at a time, beating well after each addition. Stir in chocolate mixture and vanilla. Stir in flour mixture alternately with buttermilk, beating after each addition until smooth.

BEAT egg whites in another large bowl with electric mixer on high speed until stiff peaks form. Gently stir into batter. Pour into prepared pans. Bake 30 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly touched in center. Immediately run spatula between cakes and sides of pans. Cool 15 minutes; remove from pans. Remove wax paper. Cool completely on wire racks.
SPREAD Coconut-Pecan Frosting between layers and over top of cake. Makes 12 servings.

*TOP OF STOVE PREPARATION: Heat chocolate and water in heavy 1-quart saucepan on very low heat, stirring constantly until chocolate is melted and mixture is smooth. Remove from heat. Continue as above.
notes: Coconut-Pecan Filling and Frosting (recipe on back of card)

title: German Chocolate Cake
directions: Melt chocolate in one-half cup of boiling water. Cool.
Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add egg yolks, one at a time, beating after each.
Add vanilla and melted chocolate and mix until blended.
Sift flour with soda and salt.
Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk, beating after each addition until batter is smooth.
Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.
Pour batter into three 8 or 9-inch layer pans, greased pans.
Bake 350 degrees for 35 to 40 minutes.
Cool.
Frost top and between layers with coconut pecan frosting.

title: Raspberry Coconut Cake
ingredients: 3 cups BAKER'S ANGEL FLAKE Coconut, divided
1 tub (8 ounces) COOL WHIP Whipped Topping, thawed
directions: HEAT oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
PREPARE and bake cake mix as directed on package for 2 (9 inch) round cake layers, adding 2/3 cup of the coconut to batter.
MIX jam and 1 cup of the coconut in small bowl. Spread between cake layers.
FROST top and sides of cake with whipped topping. Press remaining coconut on top and sides of cake. Garnish as desired. Store cake in refrigerator.
Makes 12 servings.

title: Coconut Sour Cream Layer Cake
ingredients: 1 large container frozen whipped topping, thawed
directions: Split layers.
Combine sugar, sour cream and coconut.
Blend and chill.
Reserve one cup of mixture for frosting.
Spread remaining portion between layers.
Combine reserved mixture with whipped topping and ice the cake.
Seal in an airtight container and refrigerate for three days before serving.

title: Tunnel of Fudge Cake
ingredients: 2 cups Pillsbury's Best All Purpose Flour
3 2/3 cups Pillsbury Rich 'n Easy Double Dutch Frosting Mix (save remaining mix for a glaze)
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Generously grease bottom, sides and tube of a 12 cup Bundt fluted tube pan or 10-inch tube (angel food pan).
In large bowl, cream butter.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each.
Gradually add sugar, creaming until light and fluffy.
By hand, stir in flour, dry frosting mix and walnuts until well blended.
Pour batter into prepared pan.
Bake at 350 degrees for 60 to 65 minutes.
Cool 1 hour; remove from pan.
Cool completely before glazing and serving.
Makes 16-20 servings.
Glaze: Blend in small bowl until smooth, remaining frosting mix and 2 1/4 teaspoons water.
If necessary, add a few drops of water to make a glaze consistency.
Spoon over cool cake.
Store cake under airtight cover.
notes:
Tips: **Rich 'n Easy Double Dutch Frosting Mix and walnuts or pecans are essential to the success of this recipe. Since this cake has the soft tunnel of fudge, ordinary doneness tests cannot be used. Test after 60 minutes by observing a shiny brownie-type crust.
High Altitude Adjustment—Above 5000 Feet: Bake at 375 degrees for 60 to 65 minutes.
†Registered T.M. of Northland Aluminum Products, Inc. Mpls. MN.

title: Apple Sauce Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Add spices and egg and beat.
Dissolve soda in a little warm H2O and add to apple sauce.
Combine the 2 mixtures.
Add the flour in which raisins have been dredged.
Bake in loaf pan about 45 minutes at 350°F.
Serve warm with whipped cream.

title: Apple Cake
